title: Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath with Pub Lunch in Lacock
description: There’s so much to explore in rural England, but to get to all of its top attractions can be difficult without renting a car. This guided tour from London takes you to Stonehenge, Bath, Windsor, and Lacock with hassle-free, round-trip transport, and it offers you a guide who can enhance your visit to each famous site. Plus, an admission ticket to Stonehenge, as well as a traditional pub lunch are all included. You can also upgrade your experience for a visit to Windsor Castle.

reviews.usertext:
Overall this was an excellent tour where we felt we got our full moneys worth. Each site gives you a taste of history and an experience.

Leon was a 10/10 tour guide. He has so much knowledge and passion about the topics and kept things fun and interesting. He also gave tips and tricks to being more efficient in each destinations which overall gave us more time to do things. I would highly recommend you take tours with Leon.

We had enough time Windsor and Bath to explore and not feel really rushed. And also Enough time to learn about the history of each place. The Stonehenge was very busy as there is a shuttle which takes people from parking to the actual stones, and can take 20 mins away from site seeing. While there wasn’t much time for photos it was great to see the boulders up close. The lunch at ladock was great, it is a nice small area.

It should be noted that this ticket doesn’t include tickets to the Roman bath house however if you ask to see the baths they may on occasion let you know to see if.

We did tour 79 Windsor, Stonehenge, Lacock and Bath. Was a long day but certainly didn’t drag. We met at Victoria Coach Station and as per the tickets, we boarded around 7:30 for 7:45am departure. We were given a run down of the day and were given strict instructions on timelines, our group were great and were always on time which led for a smooth day.
Our tour was a Tuesday so Windsor Castle was closed for visitors, our guide gave us a short walking tour and then we had some free time to explore the village and were then lucky to see the changing of the guard. We then went to Stonehenge, our ticket included a shuttle to the site, we had time to take plenty of photos and walk the entire perimeter. Next stop was Lacock for lunch (included in our ticket), we pre-ordered lunch and a drink which was very efficient on arrival, we did a small walking tour then headed to Bath. We were given some guidance on things to do and then free time before heading back to London.
Our guide Eugene certainly made for an enjoyable day and the banter with Chris the driver was fun to watch.
Yes it’s a long day but if you want to see Stonehenge and experience a taste of village life, you’ll enjoy it.

Andrew (guide) and Chris (driver) are the perfect duo! What a great way to spend the day! Chris managed to get us to/from each destination which isn’t always easy with large groups. Andrew was very knowledgeable and informative on each stop. He knew so much and I loved learning everything. He prepared us adequately for each stop - time spent/return, what to expect, “tips” to get the most of the time and otherwise, just witty and fun. He was clear with all directions and expectations to keep things smoothly running. I’m not usually a fan of organized tours but this is an exception. We were pleasantly surprised and I would highly recommend it. It’s the perfect way to get out of London and see very the beautiful countryside. It’s a quick moving day but it’s the only way to get it all in. It leaves you wanting more which is perfect.

Windsor Castle was my favorite We were one of the first groups there. However, it was very rushed and we were forced to leave at changing of the guard. There was not enough time to adequately see all three events I would recommend choosing 2 of the 4 events (skip the pub lunch) The pub lunch staff was not very accommodating and the food was just okay. Bath was beautiful but all the attractions were an extra fee. The timing of our arrival and Bath tours were not aligned and required more time than tour allotted.

One more important thing There was no water included on the 12 hour tour. Bring your own water and snacks You can buy snacks at each of the stops but they are pricey. Bring rain gear because the tour doesn't stop just because of rain

This trip was an okay trip. Let me first start by saying the tour guide/lead, Leon, was great. The driver was great. Overall, I enjoyed the trip. If you are okay with taking a long journey out of London for the day, hopping on and off the bus at stops, and having limited time to see the sights, then this tour is for you.

We had maybe 30 minutes at one stop, 45 at another, and an hour at another. You really don't get to enjoy or fully experience what's on offer. You spend more time on the bus getting to sites than you do at the actual site itself. However, I enjoyed the drive and journey. You definitely get to see parts of the rural countryside. The line for stonehenge was probably half a mile long. You have to get off your coach bus, walk down to join the queue to get another bus to drop you off to the stonehenge. Walking is an option but it is a mile and half (1.5 miles) walk.
The queue to get the shuttle took us about 35 minutes. So all we had time to do was get off the shuttle at the stonehenge, look and get back in the queue to go back down to get on our coach. We didn't even have time to walk up to the stonehenge up close for pictures because the queue to go back down on the shuttle was long and we didn't want to get left. Oh yes, people got left there and at Windsor too. I think we left 4 people in the whole journey for not coming back on time.

At windsor, they lock the gate at changing of the guards and you cant get out for 10 minutes. The workers said the drivers on the coach wont leave but we left a couple there fore sure. So be on time.

The pub lunch is a no. I think there is a tour without the lunch and I wish I had taken it. They have four options (fish/chips, vegan burger, pie/mash, and something else). The food wasn't good and the process for it was a bit chaotic if you ask me. If you are expecting to see Lacock village, then you won't see it because you only have about 30 minutes to eat and you may spend 15-20 of that waiting for food. I was the last person served so I only had about 10 minutes to eat. Luckily I did not need the full amount of time because the food wasn't good anyway.

Again, I honestly enjoyed the journey of seeing the countryside, the tour guide (Leon) and the driver.

Beware! I specifically booked the most expensive tour that stated that all the entries to the sites are included. However, on the bus the Guide announced that Roman Bath entry is not included. On my question what is "included" he answered "Entry to the town". I did not check if "the entry to the town" really requires a fee. In addition, the start was chaotic. Obviously, tourism is booming and companies are eager to get money but not ready to accommodate the crowd. Paid Lunch was promoted. Hopefully, organization and transparency on what is included in the tour will improve.

The only reason I didn’t give five stars was because of the bus we took - it had no working bathroom and no WiFi as was advertised. I had to book airline seats on our drive to Stonehenge and had to turn on my international travel plan to do so since there was no WiFi. And the trip home after the pub stop had a lot of bumps that kept reminding me there was no toilet.
Aside from that the trip was definitely five stars. It was a full day and gave us ample time at all of our destinations. Steve and Nuno were both EXCELLENT - Nuno was a master driver and Steve kept us informed and entertained during the bus ride which made the travel time pass very quickly. The pub lunch was in a great little town and was yummy (it turned out to be a 5pm dinner for us which we knew at the beginning of the trip so we grabbed some lunch as we left Windsor Castle). Highly recommend but ask about WiFi and the bathroom if that’s important to you.

What an incredible day we had with Pepe touring Windsor, Stonehenge, and Bath. We were a large group of twenty five or so but Pepe - our wonderful guide - somehow kept us all on schedule throughout the day. PremiumTours has everyone arrive early to Windsor Castle, so we were first in line to tour. Pepe had great stories to tell, although sometimes they were hard to hear because some people were happily chatting in the back of the bus. We had a lot of freedom to explore Windsor, Stonehenge, and Bath on our own. We loved every minute of the busy day and are so appreciative of how well organized the tour was. Our only regret was that we were unable to spend more time at Windsor because the Jubilee activities caused a delay in our start time. The driver (Andre?) was cheerful and brilliant at maneuvering the massive bus around tight corners. The bus was pretty comfortable, but the rows of seats were close together and there were no outlets to charge our devices on the bus. All in all, though, we are so happy to have been on this delightful day long tour.

This was an excellent tour. It is a very long day—our guide Lucy—made the time go quickly with in-depth commentary, and an impressive knowledge of seemingly everything related to the area. Even though the tour was 12 hours plus, Lucy was as communicative and informative at the end of the day as when the tour started before 8am. I would highly recommend this tour. Make sure to ask for Lucy.

One day tour to this places was quite amazing and when you exploring england these are the best tours to get connect with where they can arrange some the gem 💎 in very short span of time. The tour, plan, timings of places, were best but not to forget that the tour guide and the driver what a guys they are smooth driving at a time and the knowledge of guide was mind-blowing which i ever heard in my life. So don't waste your time to wake up late and go for club just for 2 hours of slow dance hanging beers in your hands 😅 take this opportunity to free yourself from the busy life of london🥳

Awesome tour (but way too much people on the tour about 58) Our tour guide Leon was very knowledge and personable and Ricardo was a great driver.

Our first stop was Windsor Castle but it was closed due to the Queen's passing. We viewed the Castle thru the gates and explored the town.

Before our next stop to Stonehenge, Leon took our lunch order and phoned ahead so that we wouldn't be waiting around for our lunch in Lacock. Stonehenge was pretty busy, there was a line waiting to board a shuttle bus to take you to Stonehenge. You can walk it, but its about 1.50 miles. We opted for the shuttle bus which was about a 15 minute wait. Then we factored in another 1/2 hour to line up for the shuttle bus and walk to the parking lot, which doesn't give you enough time to enjoy it since we had to be back at the bus at a certain time to the next stop which is Lacock for lunch.
Lacock is a quaint little time and lunch at the George Inn. I had the fish & chips and my hubby had the pot pie, they were both very good.
Next stop was a little town called Bath. Bath was beautiful. We had about 10 minutes to spare before the Roman Bath was closed to let tourist in and tours needs to finished by 6:00 pm. We hurried thru it and some things we didn't get to see since we had to be at the bus by 6:00 pm.

Overall the trip is wonderful, but like with any tours there should be more time for each sites. Since, we didn't get to explore inside Windsor Castle I wished that they had shaved some time off of that and added it to either the Stonehenge for Bath.

Long tiring trip but worth it.

This tour was great! All four of the stops were well timed out and gave us enough time to sample the vibe of the location. Our guide, Andrew was informative, knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. Chris, the driver was able to navigate some VERY narrow roads with skill and precision. The food and service at the Pub in Lacock was fabulous. I highly recommend this tour!

Aside from the closure of St George Chapel and Bath Abby, the tour was well worth it. Our guide Omar was a great navigator and our driver Shawn made the experience safe and very enjoyable. Bravo!!!
Our highlight was the trip was the complete package. Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, Bath and the pub lunch in Lacock were all wonderful.

A must do when in London. Our tour guide Steve and driver Nunu were the perfect partners on this adventure. Steve was so knowledgeable, entertaining and funny; he kept us all very into the tour the whole time. Nunu is a great driver. We made on time in every single stop.

I cant even begin to explain how everything was organized and packed in a day. I was a little worried when i saw some comments about “tour being rushed” . We didnt feel that at all, first of this is a group / timed tour so know that you do need to keep an eye on the time. Steve and Jermaine “ the magnificent “ made sure we are comfortable in the Coach, drive was smooth and we had some down time where we got to rest on our way back to London. Steve ( with the travel duster) was very helpful and very patient with all our questions. He also made sure while we know the history of the place that we also have fun during the ride with his humor. This is definitely a tour you dont want to miss when in London.

Just some tips especially for families travelling with kids: BRING LOTS of SNACKS , water , and maybe some activity books while in the bus. Lunch can be late lunch or early dinner so it helps to have something to munch on. I did come prepared so kids enjoyed the ride!

There is a potty in the bus which is also a plus so you dont need to worry about having to go.

It was a great exprience. The journey started and finished on time. The tour guide (Zozo) and driver Ricardo were very professional. The guide (Zozo) was talking about all places as we were going through, from London Victoria Coach Station to the end point. He was very knowledgable. I highly recommend this tour to whoever comes to London on holidays or whoever lives in London and did not have chance to visit this places. Appreciated guys.

Let me start by saying the description of the package is not very accurate. It makes it seem like it’s a completely guided tour which it is NOT! The tour starts on a bus driving to Windsor and is guided by a person on the bus, our guide Annamarie was fantastic. Once you get to the castle it’s guided by audio. Then you head off to Stonehenge and that isn’t guided at all. After that you go to Bath which is where the trip starts to go off the rails. First they don’t give you nearly enough time at any of the locations but Bath is the worst because they tell you it’s nothing more than a shopping trip because the Roman bath house isn’t included and you don’t have time to even go in to see it if you wanted to. This part of the trip was definitely the most frustrating. After that you go for lunch/dinner in a tiny village at a pub. Food was blah and by then you are pretty much over the excursion and just want to go back to London which is another 2 hour bus ride. Overall it was ok not great. You are rushed through everything and don’t get to see nearly as much as you’d like. I’m not sure if I’d recommend it. My suggestion would be take a train to everywhere but Stonehenge and spend less money on tickets and take your time enjoying the beautiful sites.

Leon was a terrific guide to have for a long day of touring. Informative, funny and entertaining. He’s been a guide for 3 years and had equal parts of enthusiasm & experience. The day of the tour was chilly but no precipitation. The trip departed only a few minutes late in a comfortable white double decker bus operated by expert driver Tallguy (seriously!). We started off to Windsor Castle. We waited 45 minutes outdoors to enter the grounds of Windsor & were advised by Leon to refrain from taking photos of the interiors. Guests are at their leisure to stroll freely for over an hour. After our satisfying Windsor visit we reboarded the coach & headed to the legendary Stonehenge! We parked 700 hundred yards or so from the site & we were given the option to walk (20 minutes or so) or take the site shuttle bus. We chose the shuttle as the cold wind was ripping over the treeless grounds. We arrived within 5 minutes. After a brief walk we arrived at Stonehenge itself. The cloud cover morphed from light to dark allowing for some striking shots! We departed after 40 minutes and had lunch at a pub that dated back to the 14th century. The offerings were fish & chips, sausage & chips, cottage pie or mushroom risotto. We chose the pie & fish and chips. Beverages are not included in the tour cost. We were both satisfied with the quality and quantity of our respective lunches. We moved back to the bus and onwards to the Roman baths in Bath! We travelled for over an hour to reach our final tour spot. The baths are just absolutely stunning. The waters are unsafe (closed since 1978 due to meningitis being detected in the ancient Roman waterlines). The setting & original design combined with the lighting and time of day make for a stunning setting. I really could imagine roaming in the footprints & mindset of those who’d experienced this open air spring bath in it’s heyday. Truly a magical space.

I highly recommend this tour for its thoroughness & efficiency. Leon was terrific. Our driver was excellent & made sleeping between destinations quite easy & comfortable.

We quite enjoyed this tour. Definitely a whistle stop tour but would be perfect for overseas visitor wishing to cram in as much as possible. Without doubt, our enjoyment of the tour was maximised further by Frank the tour guide and the driver Jim. Frank was a very funny and very clever - even enroute to and from he knew lots of interesting facts about English history and the buildings. He was so good we tried to find another tour, just to see him.

The bus we travelled on was spacious and comfortable too with a toilet.

We would use this company again and would recommend this tour.

This gives three great highlights (Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Lacock was nice but not great. The pub lunch was yummy though. The day is packed full so the last visit for us (Bath) started after 5pm, so we were too late to try to get in and see the Roman baths. The city was fine though.

Our guide was Ben and he did a fine job giving facts and mixing in a few jokes. If you want to see the article man baths, make a beeline to them as soon as you get to town, otherwise you miss them. The admission to the baths are not covered in the price of the tour but all other admissions are.

I would recommend this tour, especially if you have limited time in the London area.

This is an ideal tour if you have a short visit time and you want to squeeze as many places as you can in your itinerary. It will be a fast paced tour and punctuality is a must. I was in an excellent bus and first went to Windsor Castle. Then to Stonehenge where we had to take a seperate bus from English Heritage. It was raining hard so made the trip more memorable. Then went to Lacock Village and had lunch. Discovered the area on my own. There aren't that many shops but I liked the chocolate shop near the pub. Also, found a well maintained red color telephone booth for a memorable pic. The ones in London are in a bad shape. Finally went to Bath. Visited its museum; had to make it snappy but there was enough time to discover the city on my own and to have an icecream! The tour guide was excellent and so was the bus driver.

The sites were great to see . But our bus door wouldn’t open and we’re we’re stuck at each stop waiting to get the door opened. 5 min each stop. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and entertaining but we got to bath while the Roman bath and the church were closed so couldn’t see them and the guide would start the tour ( if you call it that ) he would start while half the bus was still trying to get off . I was on the top and when I got off the guide was 2 blocks away where we barely knew where to even walk towards. Then after the tour we got dropped off somewhere completely different than where we got on and was told to take the train back to out locations @ 9:00 at night

The guide, Leon, was very knowledgeable and mixed historical information and current events in well. He made the long drives between sites much less tiresome. Ricardo, the driver drove smoothly and efficiently through traffic. I felt we were taken care of very well. It is a lot to squeeze in for one day. Our best experience while in England.

Such a fun tour! For our first time in London, we really want to pack in as much as we could and I'm so glad we found this tour. It absolutely delivered on showing us some of the amazing sites in England in a very comfortable and organized way. Our tour guide was Zozo and our driver was Carlos and boy did they keep us moving on schedule. They did a fantastic job of making sure our day was maxed out. It would have been great to spend more time at each location but we signed up to be on the run so that's the only thing we had time for this trip. The lunch was delicious also. Highly recommend if you want to get a lot done in one day!

This would have been nice if it was just Windsor and Stonehenge. The town of Lacock is so small, a car lined street is really all it was. Bath was very far for an hour stroll.We were rushed from area to area in crowds of other tour buses. For example we got to walk around Stonehenge once and had to rush back to catch the bus. I would have liked to spend more time in Windsor and at Stonehenge, in addition to selecting my own food especially with kids. The coach bus did not have WiFi as advertised many things in the towns are closed by the time you get there.

Our tour guide Andrew was exceptional! Extremely knowledgeable and very engaging! The tour is very well organized as well.

We were initially worried about going on such a long tour during our short stay in London but we are so glad we decided to do this tour. Visiting Windsor Castle exceeded our expectations, Stonehenge has always been on our bucket list and both Lacock and Bath were delightful. And to top it all off it did not feel like a 12.5 hour tour!

Tough we traveled alone as a couple there were individuals of all ages on our tour from infants up and everyone was able to enjoy.

We recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see even one of the sights available on this tour. You will not be disappointed!

A fast paced and tourism packed day trip. If you only have a day to get out of London, this is your trip. The tour is well organized and exceptionally run. So glad we got to see all three sights and had the chance to stop in Lacock. Our guide was full of information and a joy to travel with. The only downside was not nearly enough time at Windsor….so we will have to go back in the future. We did arrive in Bath early enough to squeeze in a tour of the Roman Baths which was exceptional, but not included.

Our guide, Omar, was excellent. He has a thorough understanding of the history and significance of each place we visited, and is a superb speaker. Likewise, our driver was excellent.

Nevertheless, in hindsight, I would have preferred to take a train and take our time at Windsor Castle and at Bath. One can easily spend a full day at either venue, with tine to take in shops and cafes and/or restaurants.

It would be a bit harder to visit Stonehenge on our own without a car, and I'm not motivated enough to learn how to drive on the left hand side of the road.

By the tine we reached Bath it was dark and raining (beginning of November). We foolishly left our umbrellas behind and there was precious little tine to see anything so we returned to the bus early after getting soaked.

If I did it again I would skip Stonehenge, which is fascinating, but remote and hard to get to, and spend a day at Windsor Castle and Bath each arriving by British rail.

With an excellent tour guide Steve M and chauffeur Lammaa, this was one of the memorable trip for my friend Harpreet and me. Harpreet was on a short trip to the UK from Dubai, and this was his first ever visit to this country, hence I wanted to take him on a day trip which he remembers and experiences true British culture, food, weather 😂 and hospitality. He got to experience all of the above except the weather as it was clear blue skies and sunny with 17-18 degrees. Although with 4 stops this day trip could feel rushed and we did feel that way, Steve M ensured we get true value for our money by sharing with us some amazing nuggets of information along the way in the coach and at these locations. All 4 of these places actually deserve a day each if you can spare but Harpreet just had one day so we had to squeeze as much as possible in this time. Thank You Steve M and Lamma - you both have been fabulous and we would love to do this again and other Premium Tours.

This tour was so much fun. Our guide Eugene was super entertaining and full of fun facts about places we visited and pointed out extra interesting stuff on the journey to each place. It was a great way to see a lot of great historical sites and escape the city for a day and soak up England's beautiful countryside. on this trip was myself thirty-something , my son 5, and parents not quite as old as the stones but close. j/k however, we all enjoyed it and I would say for a fact this tour is great for travelers of any age. I had worried my son would get bored but he said "This was such a great day!"

also allow your self enough time to buy a bottle of the ginger wine in the gift shop at stone henge its sooooo delish!

This all-day tour was very good if you want to flee the city and see the countryside. The tour guide and driver were awesome! The guide was full of knowledge, funny and professional. The driver was safe and efficient! We went on a Tuesday, and the crowds were light. The three stops were quick and organized. The lunch at the pub was ok. Drawbacks: there was no bathroom on the bus and no wifi as advertised.

I would give the staff 5 stars! VERY knowledgeable guide (Steve) and an awesome Chauffeur (Carlos). The Coach was new, clean, and very comfortable. The reason for 4 stars vs 5 is due to the itinerary....it was just too much to try to do in one day. We were extremely rushed at every stop and were constantly concerned with getting back to the bus on time to leave for the next spot. If I had it to do all over again, I would take multiple tours with less stops on each one.

All things considered, though, it was a great tour and we did get to have a taste of everything.

Caution: Trip does not deliver you back to the start. It drops you at a subway station. You have to get yourself back to the start location or your hotel. We arrived too late in the day to see the Baths. Only 1 hour at Stonehenge and no audio tours were available.
The tour guide did not give any information about the stopping spots. If you want to know about Stonehenge history, you are better off reading something on the internet. Same for Windsor Castle and Bath.
I was disappointed in this tour. I expected the guide to provide information about the sites.

Leon our tour guide was attentive, funny, and very very knowledgeable about every single location we visited and barely left drives between locations silent. He always discussed the locations in great detail, always stopping to see if there’s any questions. Leon always managed to help our group of 67 get from one place, to the next (regardless of unforeseen minor bumps on the road), with the help of the best damn double deck driver in London. Of course we were crunched for time, we were doing about 360 miles of England in 12.5 hours but Carlos always managed to cut time off of the commute and get us all there safely and efficiently. Wouldn’t want a better team to be with for this tour and my family and myself are so glad we chose this tour. There were 10 of us total, and we all enjoyed it very much!

This was a long, but awesome tour. First of all, our guide, Carol, was excellent. Our driver, Carlos, was also excellent. Carol, was very knowledgeable about London and its history. She was very thorough in making sure that we, (ALL 50+ of us) knew where we should be at what time. Nobody got lost!!

I had a fantastic trip with tour guide Karen and driver Richard. Windsor was great and Karen showed us all around the most famous sites and then let us explore where we had brunch in a cafe on the Thames watching the swans go by. Then we went onto stonehenge and even though the traffic was bad at times driver Richard navigated around it and Karen organised it so that getting our tickets was quick and easy giving us the maximum time in stonehenge. Then we went to Bath and again the tour was informative and interesting. A really good day and would highly recommend this coach trip in the future!

Very enjoyable tour to see Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. We had the most amazing guide Zozo and driver David. There is a lot of ground to cover, and it’s not easy to keep such a large group in line but they managed it! Don’t be concerned by the 12 hour time frame given to this tour as Zozo gave such amazing commentary all the way through that I felt like the time just flew past. Just to be aware that your time spent in Windsor Castle is quite short, so it may be good to view it as a taster on this tour, and then do another trip back specifically to Windsor, so you can stay longer. Windsor is so easy to get to by train from Central London and is a pretty town to explore further in its own right, with great shopping and cafes etc. So if you have the time, highly recommend it. Make sure you go for the pub lunch option in Lacock on the tour which is a gorgeous little village in and of itself. The pub lunch gives you a chance to experience yummy traditional English food and affords a lovely opportunity to sit and chat with your tour mates also. All in all a thoroughly brilliant day and I would highly recommend! 😊

Really loved stonehenge and Windsor Castle! The stop in the village was nice too. The bus was very comfortable, with a toilet on board as well (nice mercedes bus). Would definitely recommend if you want to see these sites! We were sad that the Roman Bath house was closed due to some errors with IT systems for ticketing, but we saw the village of Bath as well at the end of the day and went to the nearby abbey as well. Would definitely recommend.

This was a fabulous day trip from London. Each stop was filled with history and amazing sights! Our tour guide Leon (and our driver Carlos) was friendly, funny and knew all the history and made the day a blast. I 100% recommend doing this tour if you can, it’s totally worth it.

As others have noted, they attempt to do too much with too little time on this tour. Most of the day is spent on the bus with 45-60 minutes at each site. This prevents you from seeing much at Windsor Castle and leaves no time for listening to an audio guide at Windsor Castle and Stonehenge. We did not see the Roman Baths, nor was that part of the plan apparently. We arrived after they closed.
There is information about the area from the guide on the bus but you are on your own at each site.
It was not worth the time or money through this tour company. Perhaps a bag lunch, skipping the poor lunch in Lacock, would have given more time where it would have made a difference.

We loved seeing so much in one day. Stonehenge and Lacock were the highlights for us. Sadly, the Windsor castle was closed and we arrived in Bath just as many ships were closing for the day. Still wonderful to see so much. Added to our London experience. Our driver and guide were wonderful!

Fantastic trip! Went as a family with 10 and 15 year old. Everyone truly enjoyed the trip and had enough time to absorb the sites. Windsor was closed (tue/wed) but we were able to see it from afar. Stonehenge experience was great and we loved Bath, which has a true European feel in comparison to London. Lacock was a charming small town with a house from the Harry Potter movie. Ben was great as the guide, giving us plenty of time to experience the areas and providing us with very useful information. Thanks to our driver Germaine for taking good care of the passengers! Highly recommended trip to get away from the London bustle and experience this amazing countryside.

The only reason I am giving it 3 circles instead of more is due to the short day light hours and that we did not get to enter the grounds of Windsor. This tour is best taken in the months of April to October when the day light hours are longer and the weather is nicer. Unfortunately I was only able to take this tour in December.

The tour is approximately 12+ hours and the mediocre pub lunch unnecessarily whittled away the daylight (in Dec.). We saw Windsor Castle from its gate and Stonehenge was...cold & windy. The town of Windsor was nice and I would have loved to have seen Bath in the daylight. We arrived in Bath in the dark and did not get a chance to see the architectural beauty of the city, the main reason for going to Bath. One of the better part of the tour experience was our guide Frank and his driver Tony who made it an educational tour. The long bus ride was comfortable which allowed me time to nap and further adjust to the time zone. Good tour to attend on a planned slow/rest day or early on in your trip.

At Windsor, all the tour guides shouted to their groups at one time so you couldn't understand anything. Individual headsets would be helpful. We had to rush through all the sites. The guide didn't know the dollhouse was closed. We waited in line so long for the shuttle at Stonehenge we didn't have time to walk to see it up close. I enjoyed the visit to the pub on Lacock. The food was good. There was more walking than we anticipated.

I had an awesome tour guide on tour 79. He was truly the best with a sense of humor. I highly recommend as a good day trip to leave London. When touring Windsor, please don’t be a me. The coach parks in it’s own lot that is a good walking distance from the castle. It is very easy to forget the location. If you decide to step away from the group, please get someone number and head back to the bus 20 minutes before it leaves. Why so? Just incase you get lost on the way to the bus. If you do not arrive to the bus on time, you will get left. The tour company did reach out to me as I was lost trying to make my way to the coach lot. Unfortunately, I missed my ride and was directed to the lot. They was able to get me on another tour to meet with my original group. You may not be that lucky so don’t risk it. There will be a lot of walking so be ready for the walk and long ride.. I had an eventful day..

This was an excellent tour, and the tour guide was very knowledgeable. It was a lot to pack into one day. However our time was limited and we were trying to see as much as possible. That being said: the guide emphasized that much more time could easily be spent and enjoyed in all 3 stops had there been more time. Windsor is enormous and the details are astounding. The guide told us the best places to get good pictures at Stonehenge. He also recommended something while shopping for just about anyones interests in Bath

Guide was amazing and knowledgeable! There was enough time in each place. Only disappointment was that the Baths were closed by the time we made it there by 4pm. I wish they'd changed the tour up a bit to be able to have seen the Baths. The town was really neat to wander around. The chapel was beautiful! We could have easily scattered for lunch in Bath and still been able to see them. Lacock was interesting, even had a Harry Potter claim to fame as a few scenes were shot there, but certainly not enough appeal to warrant missing the Baths.

Glad we got to see everything in one day! Unfortunately it was pouring rain when we got to Bath so walking endlessly was not fun! The trip does not end where it starts so beware for trying to get back to hotels at 9 pm in the pouring rain. Our guide was kind to stay with us & flag a cab down. Ari was very knowledgeable but she gives way too much info to retain about all the kings & history. We loved Windsor & Stonehenge & the lunch was delicious in Lacock (quaint little village).

After we had started our tour which included Stonehenge, we were informed by the tour guide that we would not be going to Stonehenge due to the fact that it was June 20 the day before summer solstice and that we might get bogged down in traffic. Had we known this we would have not booked that particular tour, but we were not informed until after the tour had started. So I fault the tour company for failing to inform us in time to make a decision.

Ana Maria had a genuine interest in making sure the group was organized and comfortable. She sets correct expectations on how much time you have at each stop so you can mentality allocate your time on what's more important for you while visiting sights. She knows the locals and multiple languages. Bravo!

Great tour overall. Victoria Station bus gates where you depart were very crowded and a little chaotic. Rest of the tour was great! Our guide Leon was very informative in a fun way. Our driver Carlos did an excellent job. Loved the drop off at the end was right by an Underground station. If you really want to spend a good amount of time at Windsor Castle, it’s probably not enough time there, but it was fine for us. Walking around Bath was beautiful, but by the time we got there many shops were preparing to close. So, you may want to choose a tour with less stops.

Really great your especially if your time in England is limited and you want to see as much as possible. For starters, Windsor is beautiful. I’m not even a fan of the royal family but it was such a gorgeous place to visit. Our tour guide was Eugene, and the bus driver was Carlos and both of them went our of their way to ensure everyone had an enjoyable experience. Eugene literally goes above and beyond. Stonehenge for me was the highlight of the day. Definitely something to cross of your bucket list. The grounds at Stonehenge are beautiful and even the bathrooms are spotless. Next stop after Stongehenge is the beautiful little village of Lacock, where we stopped for an included lunch. The village is like nothing I’ve ever seen before. Literally looks like it came to life from the pages of a story book. The place is so beautiful it doesn’t look real! If you stop here, please be sure to support the locals and purchase some homemade preserves. All proceeds from their sales are given to charity. If you don’t have cash, they have a sign with their Paypal info for your to send the money electronically. Final stop on the tour was the city of Bath. This was probably the only issue with the tour. Due to the stop in Lacock, it puts you in Bath around 4:40ish. Most of their stores close at 5. By the time we unboarded the bus, and walked to the city center mostly everything was closed. The ice cream shops do stay open a bit earlier though, which is something to take advantage of because it was honestly some of the best ice cream I’ve ever tasted. Oh, the store front used for The Modiste is also in Bath for any of my fellow Bridgerton fans. Still was a beautiful place to visit. All in all, the your is worth the price. We were able to visit so many beautiful places within just one day.

We really enjoyed this trip, Bath was fantastic and the pub in Lacock was amazing. We were a little disappointed that we only got about 45 minutes to explore Windsor, but that's what happens when you book a "highlight" tour. Our guide, Richard, was brilliant! His knowledge of the attractions, along with his fantastic sense of humor, made for a memorable day. Would highly recommend.

Excellent tour guide and bus driver! The guide really knew the history of the area and all the sites we passed. It was a ton to fit into one day, so if you like to take your time to see an area, this is not the tour for you. But, if you are trying to see as much as possible in one day, this is perfect. About 7:30 am - 8:45 pm

This trip was a great experience! All parts of the trip were interesting. Windsor Castle was a highlight and while the stop in Lacock for lunch was short, the food was great and the town is cute to see! If you go on this trip, please be sure to follow the times your guide sets for you so you don't disrupt the flow and other peoples experience. It was a long day, but you get to see so much of England and the drive is beautiful.

Our tour guide Steve and our bus driver Ray were both great! Steve had so much information to share and was very through with instructions. Ray was a safe and confident driver.

Pros:
Excellent guide and driver, clear instructions at coach station, clean and comfortable bus and well organized. You do get to see quite a lot in a day but…

Cons:
The truth is that there is just too much crammed in one day. We were amongst the first at Windsor castle, and yet you can only truly visit either St George’s chapel or the estate rooms. Forget about the Queen’s dolls collection. We had 45 minutes to visit, as you have to leave before the change of guards at 10:50. So be advised, pick one and take your time to enjoy it. We rushed through and it felt like a waste.
Stonehenge was great. Lacock and the drive there were both fantastic. By the time you get there though, it’s 15:30 so make sure you eat throughout the day. The food was just ok (you’re so tired by the time you get there, you don’t care if it’s good or not to be honest).
Bath is a complete waste. One hour in a city? When all the shops and the Roman Baths are closed? This stop should be removed from the tour. For our group, this last stop changed our experience from a 4 or 5 star experience to aggravation. The 2.5 hour drive back from Bath surely confirmed my point.

Do not go on this tour if you have poor mobility or are a slow walker, you will not enjoy it.

I had an amazing day and Carol with Ricardo made sure that all of us are doing well and comfortable. Carol is extremely sweet and very knowledgeable about the history and kept us busy along the way describing and explaining all the different things we saw around.
Highly recommended day trip!

Clive the tour guide was amazing. Trip was disrupted due to a mechanical issue with the bus and so the trip was very rushed beyond Windsor Castle however Clive and the bus driver did their best to rearrange things. Stonehenge, although very hot and rushed, was beautiful. Not many solo travelers if you are looking to make friends with other solos, however I did still meet some great people. Lancock village was beautiful. Overall, a great day despite the issues and being rushed.

We were not informed by the operator that Windsor Castle is close every Tues and Wed. Obviously it’s a regular closure so operator should have informed . More than half of the group were shock when we arrive at the coach station.

Very disappointed and unprofessional cos it’s one of the highlight of the tour. Complete waste of time to spend > 1 hour outside the castle walking. I wouldn’t book if I knew it beforehand.
The description of the tour is misleading.

Omar was absolutely wonderful. He even worked out a snafu that happened at Windsor castle. It took nearly 45 minutes for him to work it out which caused most of our other excursions to be shortened. It was beyond his control and he did his best to work diligently to get the problem resolved.
Chris our driver got us from one destination to the next with ease. This is a very very long day so be sure you are acclimated to London time before you venture out to do this, it’s about 12-13 hours. I highly recommend this tour and would certainly love to do one of the other day tours when/if I come back to the UK.

Such a great day! The weather was beautiful for a tour around Windsor and Stonehenge. Derek was a great guide, and extremely knowledgable. Jermaine was a wonderful driver, who kept us to our schedule. The one minor downside was no chargers/Wi-fi on the bus but you get to appreciate the countryside.

Leon was our guide and he was very knowledgeable and friendly. Lots to see and do. All three attractions were excellent to visit. Great way to see small country villages. It rained all day and we got very wet, even with ponchos, boots and umbrellas, so I suggest packing extra dry clothes. This would’ve came in handy instead of purchasing dry clothes at the gift shops. Overall a very good tour and I would recommend.

Both the driver and guide were professional and had a great knowledge about their job. The trip was advertised for 12 hours and it seemed like there was never a dull moment. If I had a take away, it would be a paper that had a list of the highlights from each place or to have paper to wrote down some of the history we learned.

Amazing trip!! We went to 4 beautiful places in approximately 13 hours. Everything ran very smoothly, on time and organized. The best parts were the great tour guide Eugene , very knowledgeable and friendly, and the driver Andre who got us safely and timely to all our destinations.
Highly recommend this tour!

This tour was a really great way to see a lot of the English countryside surrounding London in a short period but it is a bit rushed. It does not leave you a lot of time at the various places because you do spend quite a bit of time driving. Our guide Eugene was really great! He gave us lots of information of the history and tidbits of where we were going but also left quiet time for us to rest and sleep if we desired. I am also not sure how our bus driver Hyda was able to move such a large vehicle through all those tiny streets! It was a really good overview but will likely leave you wanting to go back to explore some more!

The driver and the guide did a wonderful job…very professional and knowledgeable. We saw a lot of amazing things on our journey…just wish we had a little more time (only an hour or so per) at each location. There was just too much stuff to see and experience. We were there and back in 13 hours which seems like plenty but there’s a considerable amount of drive time and waiting in lines that has to be done.

There was a lot to cover in 12.5 hours. There are only a couple places you can see at Windsor castle and that was disappointing seeing how huge the place is. The rest of the tour was wonderful! Loved the city of Bath. So cute. Stonehenge was great! And the luch was delicious. So much history in such little time. Lucy was so knowledgeable and a great guide. Eddie the coach driver was an expert at getting us around. Great experience!

Both my girlfriend and I really enjoyed this tour. Our tour guide Leon was fantastic - he is very knowledgeable and engaging and really enriched our experience of the sites we visited. The itinerary start to finish was well-planned and executed.

Recently enjoyed this tour. Stonehenge is truly amazing. The opulence of Windsor Castle was breathtaking. The pup lunch was actually rather good and very well organized. The visit to Bath was a disappointment as we arrived too late in the day and most shops were closed. Really just spent about an hour walking in the rain waiting for the bus to come back.

I did not feel rushed and had the right amount of time at each stop (Bath might have been more enjoyable had the shops been open). Recommend this tour.

This tour was excellent. We had a great time mostly due to our tour guide Zozo. He really knew his stuff and thoroughly explained the sites and all points in between.
I would also strongly recommend Premium Tours. Every part of the trip was organized and stress free.
Zozo and the driver are professionals. Try to get a tour with them and you'll have a great time........and you may learn something as well.

This is a fast paced “taste” of all these places. If you are looking for a leisurely tour this is not it. But having said that, we enjoyed our day very much and Mark was a great tour guide. You get to see three amazing places but be prepared you will not have much time at each location. We took this tour because we were short on time and wanted to see these sites. The pub lunch in Lacock was wonderful. This tour company does offer the same tour without lunch that gives you a little more time in each location. Overall it was a great day and we now know where we would like to go back to and spend more time. Thank you Premier Tours- we enjoyed both of our tours with you this week! Lisa and Mark were both delightful!

Really great and fun trip!! I was a bit worried at first because I thought I purchased an all inclusive for Roman Baths, Stonehenge, (Windsor was closed) so I would advise buyers to read very carefully and make sure you are purchasing what you want. The wording can be confusing.

Honestly though Eugene and Lamma made things so easy. Eugene was a great tour guide and offered a lot of really interesting stories and interactive. I wish we had more time in Bath it was definitely my favorite stop!

Highly recommend!!!

My son and I took this tour in March 2020. Stonehenge was on his list of things to see on our trip but wasn't on mine. I'm so glad we went. It was so cool to see in person. Our guide Leon was funny and we learned so much listening to him. Our driver Ricardo was amazing getting the bus through some very narrow roads. Lunch was great too! I would highly recommend this tour and request Leon as your guide. You won't be disappointed!

Very well organized and a fun excursion away from London's crazy traffic and crowds.
Our guide (Andrew) was very informative and entertaining. This was a family highlight of our trip to London!
Consider this a great way to see the sites noted and allow one to prepare for future trips (with more lengthy stays) to each of the destinations.

The tour was such a great way to take a field trip outside of London for the day without the hassle of making the arrangements ourselves. Our Guide was knowledgeable and quite funny, which made the trip even more enjoyable. We had plenty of time to read and walk the entire Stonehenge area and museum. Windsor stop was quite rushed as there is just so much to learn, so if this stop is your reason for the trip, would go there separately and spend the day. The Pub Lunch and Lacock was so cool and it was so interesting to see a village that hosted much of the filming for Harry Potter movies. Loved it all

Organization on boarding is a mess. You can't understand the person calling out the tour and their are similar named. We had to cit our tour short because of traffic. This was caused by work on a gas line. They could have checked this before hand.

Our guide Ann Mary and driver Michelle are excellent! This tour is a must go. It lasts more than 10 hours so it is really worth it. Ann Mary provided a lot of history and trivia of London so we have learned a lot on the bus.

We left London at 8am and didn’t return until 8:30pm at different drop off from departure. Guide was very informative and driver was excellent. Windsor Castle both expensive and very crowded - only 1 hour inside. Stonehenge was great, Bath was on our own so Okay. Pub lunch turned out to be Pub dinner after 5pm. It was good however.

Took this tour on a Sunday and it was great! Our bus went Windsor > Stonehenge > Lacock > Bath. Eugene was a fantastic guide with many stories and Nuno was a great driver! Taking this tour was the best part of our 4-day England trip. Windsor castle was neat, especially since knowing the Queen was there. Stonehenge was interesting too; although my favourite part was seeing the sheep lol. After Stonehenge, we ate at the George Inn in Lacock- this was our favourite meal of the trip! The steak n’ ale was really good. Since we visited on a Sunday, doing Bath last was not ideal since many things were closed when we got there, but it was still cool to see. If you’re on the fence about taking this tour- just do it!

Zozo was an amazing tour guide. He made sure we were at the castle early enough to avoid crowds. Between sites he provided interesting historical information. Would definitely recommend this tour for anyone visiting London for the first time.

I highly recommend this tour!! The tour guide Karen and driver Lamar were both great. Karen was extremely enthusiastic and worked hard to make sure we stayed on schedule. As Karen would say, this tour provides just a flavor of Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, Lacock, and Bath. It's definitely a bit rushed at each of the places but allows you to see a lot in just a day. The tour was well-organized, and we were able to stay mostly on schedule throughout the day (aside from a few late participants). The lunch in Lacock was good. Despite the stormy weather on the day I went, I learned a lot and saw everything I hoped. I would absolutely do another tour with Premium Tours!

Had a wonderful time on the tour and met some great friends. Eugene (tour guide) and Lamar (driver) were fantastic. The day could have ended horribly as I could not find the departure point for the bus. Maybe it was my ignorance. Either way they waited on me after I called the office so I didn't miss the trip. I thought we spent a decent amount of time at each location and Eugene was very knowledgeable. Overall, I would highly recommend this tour.

Great trip, however, be sure to read the fine print. The description states it includes tickets for a portion of the trip but it doe not. Once I joined the trip, I was told I needed to purchase additional tickets to enter Windsor and Stonehenge. Had I known prior to the trip, I would have already paid. Instead, I had to be pulled aside by the tour guide and pay. As they did not accept Euro, I had to go to an ATM for cash to cover the four. The inconvenience was disappointing.

worth taking the trip for quick round about experience about the 3 places and fish and chips at a village pub.
staff , driver and guide were excellent and kept to the time. any wants more detailed visit to windsor castle need to take a whole day trip to the castle. security and formalities take a long time.

One of the best tour indeed. The tour was such a great way to take a field trip outside of London for the day without the hassle of making the arrangements ourselves. Our Guide was knowledgeable and quite funny, which made the trip even more enjoyable.

Carol was an excellent guide but this tour attempts too much in too little time. Going all the way to Bath to see so little of the city was a real disappointment. If I could choose again, I would do two of the three sites and maybe skip the pub lunch, which was just adequate.

Fantastic tour! Our guide was amazing and the sights were incredible! The pub lunch was so good, and I’m a VERY picky eater. The only thing that keeps is from being 5 stars is that you really don’t get to spend much time in any of the places. It feels very rushed.

Was able to see quite a variety of sites in a relatively short time. Felt a little rushed but had to be to get it all in. Would have been good to get to Bath before all the shops were closed, but it was still good to have been there. Highly recommend the tour. Great value and excellent tour guide.

Eugene and Andre were our guide and driver respectively. The entire trip was made enjoyable because of them. Eugene's knowledge is admirable and his enthusiasm brought up the entire atmosphere. Coupled with the amazing views of Windsor castle, Stonehenge and the city of Bath. Highly recommended!

A lot of drive time, but a wonderful way to see the scenery of England. Eugene was a fantastic tour director, one of the best we've had in our many travels! Time at Stonehenge was adequate; could've used hours more at Windsor Castle; arrived late in Bath so they were closed, but were able to shop at some of the stores that were still open. Lunch in Lacock was excellent and the town was beautiful! Overall, the trip delivered on everything promised.

Our tour guide was great! Tried to give us as much time as he could at each stop. He even gave us a walking tour of bath since the tickets where sold out to the Roman Baths, (which wasn’t his fault or the tours… it was the jubilee weekend). The pub was so cute in the 13th century town was fun to walk around and get a little history on it. I would definitely recommend to Friends and family

We’ve traveled alootttt and have been on many, many, manyyyy tours in our life! This is by far the best by a long shot! Windsor castle was amazing! Because of Nuno and Léon, we arrived so early, we got 1st in line! Excellent time management skills! We then went to Stonehenge, which was also amazing! We had plenty of time to view everything, shop and bathroom breaks! Lastly was bath, we got 2 hours to explore which was more than enough time. The views were amazing!

However, what stood out the most to me was Léon and Nuno’s brilliant bromance. They were incredibly funny, silly, charming and just straight up fun! They were so amazing! I can’t say it enough. They gave us suggestions, they were so accommodating and just kind. Leon and Nuno are reasons people come back and want to do this. They are both special! I’ve never laughed so much on a tour! I will never forget this special day!

Thank you Nuno (Sorry if I misspelled it) and thank you Leon (Trevor Noah), many blessing to you both!

This tour turned out to be the highlight of our trip. Extremely well organized guide, really knew his stuff. Windsor castle was awesome, warned us not to get stuck by the guards changing as we may miss the bus. 2 people did :(, but caught up to us at stonehenge. Explained what to do if that happened. A wealth of knowledge throughout the tour, prepared us for each stop. Non stop history while traveling to each location. Seemed to know where and when to be to beat the crowds. Highly recommend Magnus Nielsen for your tour!!

Great highlights tours. If your like me and try to see as much as possible while traveling for work, this is a great way to do it. Fantastic tour guide and highly skilled bus driver. Would definitely recommend for those that don’t like puttering around at one place all day. 👍🏼👍🏼

This tour was fantastic. Zozo was a great guide full of historical facts and funny stories. He always went out of his way to accommodate everyone and gave us a nice walking tour of Bath at the end since we had time. Cheers to the best bus driver Andreas! Highly recommend.

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. It is a busy one and do not expect to linger. Lots is covered. Our driver Carlos was a gem. And our guide, Leon was exceptional. He shared historic and current information. He made what could have been dry and dull into an interesting and fun tour. He was very organized, patient and kind with guests that required it. We ended with a delicious fish and chips dinner in the village of Lacock. It is a great way to checkout these historic and beautiful UK places.

Loved it! All of us! Our guide Lusie was exelent! We learned a lot. It is worth every penny? Windsor was such a nice, royal place. Stonehenge shows you that we still don't understand everything. Lunch was really good and everyone from my family loved fish and chips

This trip was fun filled. Our tour guide Andrew knew what he was talking about. He is very informative and entertaining. We came to the Windsor Castle early to avoid crowds, which we did. Stonehenge was amazing and the Dinner in the oldest pub in Lacock was also an experience.

This was a beautiful trip through the countryside of England and Karen was a very good tour guide. The pub lunch in La Cock was probably my favorite part because I got to see more of what local life is like. There were shopping opportunities, however I felt like we only got a short time at each of the destinations. I suppose that was necessary because this was a 12 hour tour already!

This was an excellent trip. The itinerary was great and our guide was brilliant! It was well planned, the coach was comfortable the guides comments and instructions were spot on. I pull mot hesitate do book another tour like this again.

A great big thank you to our driver, Carlos, and our guide, Eugene. We had a great time and learned a lot of history. Even though we spent a lot of time on the bus, it was very comfortable, and the scenery was beautiful. It was nice to see the countryside outside of London. Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge are a must see on any trip to London. It was a long day, but so worth the trip. Would highly recommend.

Great trip! Our guide Scott and Driver Ricardo were amazing. So Nice to get out of London for the day and see the English country side. I thought Stonehenge was going to be the best part of the trip. It was fairly underwhelming. Next time I would
do a half day at Windsor castle and half day in Bath. Laccock was cool but didn’t get there until 5pm. My advice would be spend more time at each location, probably too much to do in one day. I would def travel with this group again. Highly recommend!

It was a long and beautiful day—never would’ve experienced these four unique spots without awesome duo Carlos the driver and Andrew our guide. Thank you so much Andrew for your sparkling historical and colorful notes about everything from London to LaCock. Would highly recommend and see if you can get Andrew as a guide! He is spectacular. Wish we could’ve spent longer in Windsor Castle but it was a mad dash to the finish line. LaCock is the most enchanting village with magical hedges of cats and dogs. Cheers!!!

Be prepared to hit several amazing attractions over the course of an entire day! This tour was unbelievable and you will be exhausted by the end, but it is totally worth it. First, the company, Premium Tours, makes sure you get to Windsor Castle before the other tour groups so you are first inside the castle. Second, the timing of our guide was impeccable. We had enough time at each stop to enjoy the attraction before climbing back on the bus to catch the next one. I highly recommend this tour and would use Premium Tours again.

Peter and Pringle did an excellent job. Peter is very informative and entertaining. The busy day was filled with great adventure. While this is a very full schedule the time allotted was certainly adequate. The lunch was absolutely amazing. Best steak and ale pie I have ever had. My granddaughter had the fish and chips and it was also very good. This is a. Wry full day, however it was the best way for us to see these sites in a short amount of time.

Our Tour guide Leon and driver Carlos were both amazing. We learned so much on our trip. Bus was comfortable and we were lucky to travel with a good group of people. Loved every part of this tour and highly recommend!

While a long day the ride was fine and we were given great advice for each venue on how to enjoy our time. The only thing I missed was not being able to get to the royal crescent in Bath. But that’s only because I walk too slowly and it is a bit far from the drop off point. We enjoyed our time there and the pub dinner in Laycock was good. Just be prepared to get in late (8:30 -9pm) to London.

The day started with perfect weather. We had a great tour team with Clive our perfect guide and Nuno our awesome driver! They took great care of us and the timing was impeccable. All the sights we visited had the best sequence. We didn’t lose much time and everyone in the group was prompt. Highly recommended and don’t forget your tip at the end, it’s worth every Pound! 😎

Windsor, Stonehenge and Lacock were great but way too short. Having the Bath visit last meant everything was closed except shops and restaurants. What good is it to go if you can’t see the Abbey and the Roman Baths? Too many things in one day. The guide Eugene was very knowledgeable and the driver Andre very good. But each location needs much more time.

Excellent and efficient tour! Well run itinerary, and Andrew the tour guide was the best! If you only do one tour outside London, do this one. Each site is very different, and very beautiful. Highly recommended. 10/10!

The tour was fantastic. Our guide Richie was great, He made the trip even more special. The bus was comfortable. Bring plenty of water to drink. Non is provided. The pub we stop to have dinner was cozy and the food was great. I have to admit the trip was long (12 hours) but it was well worth it.
Fantastic tour. Great, personable and professional guide and driver!! 3 days worth of content packed into one day. A truly great adventure!! Thanks to Ben the guide and Andre the driver!!

This was a great experience. I’ve been on a few days trips, and this was the best. Our tour guide Clive was great and our driver Mo was amazing. We had plenty of time at each stop, and the lunch was delicious. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Our tour guide Andrew was exceptional and the tour very interesting and entertaining. Would have preferred a little more time in Windsor, was rushed to get through the castle, Stonehenge was delightful, lunch in Laconia delicious. Bit disappointed didn’t get a drive by of Roman bath, but Cathedral was interesting. Only hiccup was tour didn’t include admission ticket to Stonehenge even though receipt said admission was included- very misleading

A very good lunch, served well, and not too expensive. We arrived early for our meal, and it was a god idea, as the pub got very busy. Our servers Rebecca, and Megan looked after us very well, and the meal was vey good indeed. We will be back to this Pub again soon.

Both my husband and I enjoyed this tour! Gavin with a G, really made sure we were well informed with England’s history. Gavin is an amazing host and our driver Carlos was always on time and an amazing driver! They were both extremely nice! We loved going to Stonehenge, there wasn’t any wait line. Bath was rainy but still an amazing experience. We loved the pub in Lacock! It gives you a feel of back in the day. I would totally do this again. I highly recommend it

We truly enjoyed our bus trip today. Our guide Carol and our f]driver Abdul were fantastic. It was great to travel the countryside without the hassle of figuring out how to get there. Carol and Abdul got us to Windsor early enough to be the first group in line. They were very clear in how to get back to the bus after each stop. It was a great time.

We had a lovely day and our tour guide Andrew was amazing! He knew so much about London and the sites we visited. Loved Bath and Stonehenge. Wish we had more time in Windsor but that wasn’t possible. The tour gave us a great overview.

This tour was one of the best I have ever taken. The tour director Dan was so wonderful, witty, entertaining and well versed in each destination. The driver James was friendly and a REALLY GOOD DRIVER, never felt unsafe and those roads are crazy to negotiate. I was in front seat. Dan went out of his way to answer all our questions. I feel like I could have flown to England for one day, taken this tour and experienced this beautiful country, then flown home happy.

Wi-Fi was not working, guide called Frank was probably nice and attentive to all the white people on the tour and was obvious that he did not like Asians very much. He ignored us as much as he could. Even when we were right in front of the bus waiting to board, He chose to attend to all the others who DID NOT queue up and let them board the bus first.

Never once did he check on us and even when we tried to get his attention as we had to clarify some issues he would avoid eye contact and pretend he didn't see us. This lasted all the way till we ended our tour he thanked everyone who got off the bus EXCEPT us. He just turned away and pretended he didn't see us.

We liked everything from the tour except the guide. Disappointing experience. Would not book again.

A couple of the advertised highlights of this tour are “early entry” and “first group to enter” Windsor Castle. We left Victoria Coach Station just before 8am. We didn’t get through security and listening to the instructions of our guide until 10.25am and we had to be through the exit 20 MINUTES later, after earlier being informed that we’d definitely have enough time to do both the chapel and State Apartments. By the time we walked up to the State Apartments, we only had 10 minutes to race through this expansive section of the castle filled with beautiful history (that we were unable to take in) before having to race for the exit gates as they shut for the changing of the guard at strictly 10.45am, or we were told we’d be left behind. It really ruined the whole day for me. I had been so looking forward to seeing the castle.

I understand there were traffic hold ups but we still arrived at the castle before it opened and no effort/offer was made to us to re-adjust the day.

We had 90 minutes at Stonehenge (we found out ourselves you can download an audio guide app for your phone) which was sufficient to take in the site and spent 60 minutes in Lacock for lunch, a quaint village.

We had 75 minutes in Bath so if you want to look at the Roman Baths you will have to go through quickly and you won’t have time to do much else. Perhaps lunch could be at a pub in Bath instead which would give you more time.

The advertised wi-fi on the bus did not work.

BEWARE: if you get JULIE as a tour guide, you will be left behind if you are even 5 minutes late to pick up time. My sister and I were left behind at Windsor Castle, along with 2 other people! That’s 4 people short on headcount! We then witnessed her take a head count 3 more times and get 3 different numbers. I understand it’s a tight schedule, but we did not even receive so much as a phone call. What if something bad would have happened to me? The tour wouldn’t have known anything. Also, NO APOLOGY from Julie either.

Premium Tours did solve the problem though. We joined another coach with JASON as a tour guide. He was absolutely amazing. I watched him wait over 10 minutes past departure time to ensure all of his members were on the coach. He was very attentive and gave detailed information to those of us who were left behind by Julie (4 people).

The rest of the tour was pretty good, but the anxiety and fear from being left behind at the first stop ruined the trip. Instead of enjoying the history and culture of each stop, I was constantly checking my watch. Also, Julie does not stop talking—even on the 3 hour ride back to London. Fun facts are cool and nice here and there. But a minute-by-minute count down is not necessary.

Short version: bus had no functional wifi(no internet available); tour guide spoke the ENTIRE time with the personality of a rock; ‘lunch’ was at 540 pm after leaving at 745am; had barely an hour at each location which was barely enough time to enter, run through, and get back to bus.

1. The bus had no working WiFi, despite being advertised as such. We could connect, but had no internet access.

The guide refused to confront passengers who decided to change seats twice after the first two stops, resulting in my wife and I being split into separate rows despite being together in the front row upon boarding the bus (and our snacks/bag being on those seats). We felt he should have asked the people to move, but apparently he did not want confrontation, so he made an announcement after the second stop (and a second change of seats) that people now needed to stay where they were. Thus we were stuck the rest of the day in separate rows, despite arriving to the station early to get our choice of seats for the tour.

Also, the arrival instructions are horrible, and several people in our tour nearly missed the bus. Go to Victoria Coach station, and let them know you need Premier Tours Gate 19/20. Go there and wait for your tour to be called by tour code which is listed on your ticket. There does not actually seem to be check-in prior to the bus being loaded.

2. The guide’s recollection of facts was impressive. However, the delivery had all the charisma of a rock, and he spoke, nonstop, the ENTIRE day about mind numbing facts.

3. We were expecting lunch, but received dinner at 1740. The tour left promptly at 0745! That is way too long to force people to go without food. You can’t eat during th day, because you simply do not have enough time to do so. Luckily, the dinner itself was surprisingly good for a tour stop. Be warned, we only got around 30 minutes to eat because of my wife’s dinner being delayed.

4. You get too little time in every location. We had 1:20 at Windsor Castle, which needs several hours to see. I skipped at least half the audio tour and rushed through, walked the Cathedral, and barely made it back to the bus.

Stonehenge was an hour, enough time to see, but not absorb the site.

Bath had plenty of time, and the least to see. Sad.

Food was rushed as described before.

5. If you have one day, and need to see these stops, you may not have much choice. If not, choose a different tour.

I booked this tour for myself and my two children (ages 8 & 10). We were looking to squeeze in several of the "must see" locations in one day and this turned out to be a great way to do so. As many other reviewers stated, it is A LOT for one day and you don't get a lot of time at each location due to lines and the travel time involved to get to/between each stop, so if you are looking to see these places in depth, this may not be the tour for you. We had roughly 1-1.5 hours at each stop, and to be honest, with younger kids, it was the perfect amount of time for us. Our guide, Leon, was very funny, informative, and it was clear he enjoys his job, making it very enjoyable for all on board. He was always clear about timelines and where we should rejoin at the end of each stop. He genuinely seemed interested in providing useful and entertaining information throughout the whole tour. Just a heads up, the bus terminal where the tour departs is chaotic - there are many tours all leaving around the same time, so just go in prepared for that and you'll be ok. Once on the bus, the rest of the day is stress-free. We ate "lunch" fairly late (3:30pm) - but were told at the beginning of the day that would be the case and there were plenty of opportunities to grab a snack or treat throughout the day at other stops. Overall, we had a great time and enjoyed getting to see Windsor, Bath, Lacock and Stonehenge all in one day. The bus was comfortable and our guide was fantastic!

We booked for 2 adults and 1 child cost 414,19$ included transport, admission to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle, lunch, some free time at Bath. Not included hotel drop off or pick-up.
A long day but we saw so many beautiful places! We had enough time for Windsor and Stonehenge visit, we had a nice British lunch and time to walk about in Lacock. We could have spent more time in Bath but we have arrived a little bit late because of some asiatic tourists (they forget to come back in time after visiting Windsor -not so nice but our guide managed to resolve it)
Unfortunately, because of delay, only Christmas market was still opened in Bath and everything else closed or almost. We had an hour to walk around and I chose to see Jane Austen places.
Our guide was very good, passionate, organized and friendly. The driver did and excellent job.
We took a lot of beautiful and spectacular pictures and my son was very impressed by every sight.
We highly recommend this tour if you want to see many interesting things and places in one special day.
It is worth it!

This tour was amazing. It was a rather long day so definitely pack a snack bag with a bottled water. Our tour guide was Gavin who was both informative and hilarious. He had commentary during the bus trip to each stop and was super knowledgeable. His anecdotes and humor got us through the day! He is a 5 star guide!

First Stop - Windsor Castle - Hopefully your guide gets you there very early to avoid long lines. We were the second group in line and were to the castle within 25 minutes. I wish there was more time at Windsor to see everything though we stopped for just under 2 hours. It was pouring rain so remember to bring an umbrella! They get you through the maze of rooms in Windsor Castle very quickly. I advise taking the audio guide as reference for each room as there is too much to absorb just meandering through on your own. The Chapel was amazing, I also recommend using the audio guide during this portion of the trip as there are various tombs and art that you will miss if you do not have the audio tool as a guide. I was disappointed to find that the Doll House was closed as I was so looking forward to seeing it. We did however get to see the changing of the guard at Windsor. Headed back to the bus after the changing of the guard.

Second Stop: From Windsor to Stonehenge it was about a 2 hour drive with traffic. Use the restroom before boarding since there are no restrooms on the "luxury" coach bus. Once we arrived at Stonehenge, our guide provided us tickets to yet another bus to board which drives you up approx. 1 mile to the actual site. Again, I advise listening to the audio guide during your walk around the Henge. After about 1 hour stay at this site, we headed to Bath. Again, I cannot stress enough to use the restroom prior to boarding as the time/distance between each location is long.

Third Stop: Bath was such a quaint little town that I feel was one of the highlights of the day. The only unfortunate thing is that we had only 1 hour to enjoy Bath. My mom and I decided to tour the Roman Baths as opposed to walking the streets to shop. We quickly rushed to the line at the entrance. Stay to the right side so you can go into the "individual lines" which run way more quickly than the "group lines". Once we were in the actual baths, it was AMAZING. You felt as though you were stepping back 2000 years in time. This is a must see! Although the little shops are great, I advise quickly heading to the Roman Baths during your short stay. Off to Lacock "The George Inn" for a late lunch after Bath.

Fourth Stop: The George Inn - Lacock. This was a nice stop over at the George Inn where we enjoyed a tasty meal. They had 3 choices, chicken, beef and a vegetarian option with the risotto and mushrooms. I had the vegetarian option which was a good choice. They have a cute little chocolate shop at the back of the building where I purchased some goodies.

After a very very long day, we headed back to London from Lacock which was about an hour and a half. On the way back, Gavin made certain to make his rounds to each and every guest to assist with any questions, restaurant suggestions and to make sure that each passenger was aware how to get home from Victoria Station once we arrived back in London. He was super helpful and the most amazing guide! So glad I did this excursion...only complaint is that I wish we had another 2 hours in Bath.

Bottom line: By far our best and favorite day in London!! Packed day but you see so much! Bring a few snacks in case your Lacock lunch comes Lacock dinner! Very crowded at Victoria Station so leave time to get through

This was the most awesome day!! Our guide, Sam, was awesome. He guided us perfectly to each destination and ensured we were on time for everything.

We started at Windsor and had to wait inline just a little. If you go later in the day, the lines get longer. Windsor was our first stop. If you go later, there are some coffee shops a short walk away. Have someone stay in line and grab a cappuccino. Windsor is amazing.
