We arrived in Bath and again, only given a very short amount of time (an hour) to explore the town. By this time, we were very hungry as we did not have any time for lunch. Bath was beautiful, but would appreciate more time.

At the end of the route, we arrived at the pub dinner in Lacock. This is NOT a lunch. We arrived at the pub around 6pm. The pub was small and other people on the tour were grouchy, as this was really our first time to eat a meal. We were give a choice of meat pie, bangers, fish and chips, or risotto for dinner. I got the bangers plate, and I felt like I was eating lunch from a cafeteria. Not worth the money!

The highlight of the day was the unexpected chance of watching "Downton Abbey" being filmed right outside of the pub in Lacock!

Overall, it was a very long day. I would actually score this lower, however our guide was very patient with the more "needy" tourists in our group.

If you only have a short amount of time in London and want to see as many sights as you can, I would recommend this tour. If you are spending a couple of days in the area, do your self a favor and rent a car to avoid the headache of being on the bus.

Also, bring a lot of snacks for the bus!

My husband and I decided to pay a short visit to London for three days. We wandered around for the first two days and decided to take this tour to see Winsor Castle and Stonehenge. My husband was never a fan of doing tours and he was very skeptical when I booked it. It turned out that this was his favorite of the whole trip. Our tour guide Steve M was very funny and knowledgeable. He kept us entertained the whole trip. The trip started at 7:30 and ended at 8:30. It may sound very long but you really didn’t feel it. They gave you enough time to explore each site and take pictures. We got to see a lot within a day and didn’t feel exhausted.

The tour was magnificent, everything on time, not a minute of delay, the guide (Leno) was excellent taking care of every detail, especially the lunch arrangement, treating everyone with the same care, I recommend this trip with Leno and his driver Christian.

We're glad that we booked this tour. Except for the somewhat unorganized boarding process at the bus station - (there were too many tours at the same time at the same gates), everything else was outstanding. We had Leon for the guide and Fernando as the bus driver and they were both GREAT! One change I would recommend is to have more time at Windsor castle (we had to rush though it to make it back to the bus) and we don't need as much at the Stonehenge site. The free lunch was a nice touch. Thank you Leon & Fernando.

This was our first ever 'tour' and it was awesome and would very much recommend it! Our guide was awesome, very funny and he had a lot of information about the places we were going to see that he told us over the sound system before we actually arrived! I think we might have been one of the only ones to tip him and I felt very bad about this because he very much earned it!

The stops were long enough to explore each of the 3 sites (Windsor Castle, the Roman Baths, and Stonehenge) however due to long wait times and traffic our time was cut short at each of the locations (not the tours fault at all!). We still had plenty of time to explore each site, but not enough time to get to see the towns which looked very cute and we would have loved to have a sit down lunch and explore them. However, that is a very small issue as the rest of the tour was amazing!

This was a solo trip to the varios places near London.. And i was a bit apprehensive but was completely wrong given that we had a great guide Steve M. And a great driver Richard H. Although it was a very intense tour covering many places in 13 hours but was handled very well.. Would really recommend be it solo or with friends/family. Bus was is good condition too..

Our tour guide Dan did an amazing job. He was very knowledgeable and entertaining at the same time. James our driver did an excellent job. Dan even helped us figure out how to get back to our rental house, no easy feat for a group of 8 ladies. We would do this tour again in a heartbeat. Highlight of our trip.

My boyfriend and I were on this tour on a Saturday afternoon. We enjoyed Windsor Castle but felt rushed for time while we were there. The baths were nice, but very crowded, and Stonehenge was beautiful. Our tour guide, Leon, was very knowledgeable and funny and made our tour a lot of fun. I would recommend this tour for the sake of travel convenience, but if you want to really take your time at each stop, it may be better to do it on your own.

We had a great day. That said, it is not for everyone.

Cons:
-Busses are busses. These are very nice, but no toilets, and they were full, so no empty seats for stretching out.
-this is a lot to see in one day. Would have loved to spend more time in some of these places but let's be honest, that's not what we signed up for. We signed up for a tour that showed us 4 different places in England in one day.
-even with rapid entry, there were still queues in some places. Not the tour provider's fault, just a fact of these popular attractions

Pros
-our tour guide was entertaining and knew a few tricks to get us good places in line
-The pub lunch was surprisingly good for a country lunch for 70+ppl all at once
-these sights are amazing - Stonehenge still takes the breath away, Windsor is spectacular, bath and lacock are charming
-it was great having someone else do all the driving

We did this trip the first full day we were in Europe from the US. The long hours on the bus provided some good napping to help us acclimate to the new time zone and recover from jet lag.

I highly recommend this tour.
Our tour guide Leon and our driver Martin made sure that we were one of the first groups into Windsor Castle. We didn’t truly understand the importance of this until we saw the line behind us.
Leon was very knowledgeable and gave us lots of additional information about English history. It truly was a pleasure.

We had limited time in the UK and needed to fit as much as possible into this one tour. We did our homework, knew what we wanted to do in each location, and were ready to hit the ground running every time the bus stopped. Yes, you'll spend more time on the bus than at each site. Yes, some locations will feel rushed. Yes, you'll have to pick and choose what you do. But if you know this going in and are prepared, it is a wonderful tour. Our guide, Tara, was excellent too. She worked very hard to keep us on a tight schedule to ensure precious time wasn't lost waiting for stragglers.

Well, I had multiple issues that caused me to miss a bus. The company called me several times during the day to help me and reschedule another tour. They were all very kind helpful, and I'm so grateful they got me on another tour.

We didn't have a lot of time in London and wanted to make the most of our short stay, so this all-day trip was just the ticket. Seven of us departed from the train station VERY EARLY, and the mayhem (and crowds) at the train station while we tried to find our bus, was a bit disconcerting, but once we found the correct gate we were on our way. Karen, our tour guide, was awesome. She was not only very knowledgeable about each stop, but shared her honest opinions about how Londoners truly feel about the royal family (they love Elizabeth, her grandsons, Princess Kate and soon-to-be princess Meaghan, and the late Diana, but Charles and Camilla, maybe not so much. LOL.) First stop was Queen Elizabeth's favorite castle--Windsor. We got there before the gates opened but were among the first groups inside. The sitting rooms were as grand as you'd imagine. We didn't have time to visit the chapel or dollhouse, but were satisfied nevertheless. Next stop: Stonehenge. It was freezing on the plains, but what a sight to behold. It almost looked like a movie set! And then, we were off to Bath. This was a bit disappointing, but only because we had so little time in this beautiful village. We wished we could've "taken the waters" or at least had time for lunch and shopping, but the line to get into the Baths took more time then we bargained for Easter Week, and Karen kept reminding us of the tight schedule the bus driver was on. After Bath, the last stop was Lacock--a quaint little medieval village (scenes from Harry Potter were filmed here to my kids' delight) where we were supposed to have lunch, but by the time we got there it was more like an early dinner. Food was good in The Red Lion Inn, but there was little of it: a tiny portion of delicious fish and chips for some of my companions and what appeared to be half of a shepherd's pie for me. Perhaps they can work on the portion size in the future because when we got back to London, we were starving and needed to go grab a bite to eat.It was however, a full, satisfying day of sightseeing. I highly recommend this trip.

This tour does a fantastic job of getting you to 4 different unique locations, filling your time appropriately and enjoyably. I was by myself on a short 2 day trip to England and wanted to see a couple of the items on this list.
Trip started at Victoria Coach station on schedule, nice bus, temperature controlled, the tour guide was entertaining and talked you thru items you could see and their history as we traveled.
First stop was at Windsor Castle, and being one of the first tour groups there kept the waiting short. You don't find out until you actually get inside the rooms for display that no camera's are allowed, so although its amazing inside, and the audio tour is nice, don't expect to get pictures unless you are very surreptitious.
Next stop was Stonehenge, lunch is not provided, but its just some rocks, so 30 minutes to take some pictures and walk around is more than enough, and there is a nice diner there you can get a quick lunch over the next 30-45 minutes and then back on the road
Next stop was Bath, beautiful quaint town, plenty of shopping to do. Don't waste time looking at the one picture of the actual roman baths and decide not to go, the integrated museum is well worth it with many artifacts on display, there's plenty to do for an hour or two.
last stop is Lacock, lots of films done here, Harry Potter, etc, old buildings, the pub is nice with good food.
It may seem fast and furious, but for the traveler on the go this is perfect. If you like to stop, shop, peruse, excessively read are are slow... I would recommend the same company but only 2 stops on this list. You could spend 3-4 hours in Windsor Castle and enjoy it, same with Bath. Stonehenge is only worth 30min to an hour at most, and Lacock also unless there's eating/drinking to be done.

My wife and used Premium tours and could not have asked for a better experience. There was a very well organized and prompt departure from Victoria Coach Station and the ride was very comfortable. We got to Windsor Castle early so we could avoid the lines and enter first and our guide provided a ton of great information on the history of Britain as well as Windsor. The next portion of the tour was unfortunate as a snowfall has caused the roads to Stonehenge to be closed, but the tour company responded very quickly to the closure. We were given an immediate option of a tour the next day, a refund or entry into the Roman Baths at no extra cost. This was an excellent way to handle an unforeseen weather circumstance and we were grateful for how easy the company was to work with. We ended up spending additional time in Bath so we could tour the actual Baths and the village. We ended with a late lunch in Lacock and our guide’s vast knowledge continued as we were given a great history on the village. Overall, it was disappointing to not see Stonehenge but we understand the unpredictability of weather and had a great experience on the other parts of the tour.

This was a great tour to see so much in a short period of time! Windsor was a quick run through, but doable. Stonehenge was awesome and had plenty of time. We were late leaving Stonehenge as some members of our tour group lingered past the return time, thus we got stuck in traffic and were late getting to the city of Bathe. It was a great trip none the less. We also stopped in a small old town to eat lunch at a middle ages pub. The whole day was fantastic!

Our guide, Frank was very funny and easy to talk to. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the areas and answered everyone's questions with insight. The tour was quick but it had to be as we saw so much. A fantastic overview of many places. The lunch was really good at a very cute pub. The whole day was amazing. Couldn't ask for anything better.

This tour covered some of the major sights we wanted to visit while in England, Our tour guide Dominic was fantastic. He blended his wealth of knowledge about the sights we visited with some delightful humor thrown in for good measure. He is probably the best tour guide we have ever had. Windsor Castle was amazing as was Stonehenge. We enjoyed the visit to Bath and Lacock as well. Our driver Christian was such a careful driver and made us feel comfortable even in heavy traffic. It was a long day, but Dominic kept it interesting and fun all day. Lunch in Lacock was very good and the town is like going back in time. An excellent tour to take. We highly recommend it.

The Stonehenge and Windsor Castle are incredible. Highly recommended!
Our tour guide David is very knowledgeable. He not only provided information about all the sites in terms of the history, Archaeology and geology, also entertained us and talked about British cultural, everyday life in general. He will answer all the questions you have. We are very fortunate to have him. It was a long day, but it is so worth it! If you like history, please consider this tour!

Tour bus started out of station with a full load minus 5 people. Seats were okay to start but very uncomfortable twelve hours later. Being Canadian we were too polite to push up in line so we ended up in the back seat upper level with an empty seat right beside me which saved the day for me as you can not pick your neighbors or the smell and noises coming from them. Our guide Dominic and driver Steve were great and did get us to Windsor castle to be first in line and we waited for opening. And then the rush was on. Only enough time to get a quick tour through castle but did manage to see most without listening to full audio tour. Out of castle and into Cathedral for a very brisk walk through and out to the bus. Pub Lunch in Lacock was not a relaxed affair, off the bus, down the street, 50 odd people jam into pub to gobble down a pre-ordered meal and drink that was not included with meal, line up to pay hefty price for drinks 10 minutes to see a little of the town on walk back to bus and off we go in less than 1 hour. Bath was nice but did not get to see much and I am glad I did not buy tickets for the baths beforehand as time would not allow much enjoyment. You can not even see the baths unless you order a meal at the restaurant that hides the baths or pay for tickets. Off to Stonehenge the most important part of the tour for me and time was limited but sufficient to see all and hear all of recorded tour but not a lot extra due to a two hour trip back to city.( actually a nap for most )..Dominic was great with history lessons and comedy routines and Steve got us all home safe. A full day, and for me TOO full.
If you are looking to say that you visited the sites this is perfect your unable to explore and spend much time at each location very rushed on a strict time schedule
This trip was fantastic. Steve and Ricardo were a wonderful tour guide and driver. Four different historic locations make this excellent value for money. Highly recommended.

The sights were very interesting but I would have hard time recommending trying to do them all as we did in one day - too much bus time, too long a day - skipping the pub dinner would have be better. We went at the end of the tour and it was a let down - no charming server, mediocre food - pretty lame.
We enjoyed our tour guide Toby - he was very sweet and genuinely interested in our comfort - but the days plan didn’t allow for him to really shine - instead he spent a great deal of time focusing on shepherding a very Large group to 4 different sites, plus meal planning - it was kinda ridiculous.

Awesome trip! Our tour guide was amazing and very funny. From London, to Windsor castle and the city of Windsor (THE CASTLE IS CLOSED ON TUESDAYS SO MAKE SURE YOU BOOK ANY OTHER DAY IF YOU WANT TO SEE IT), to a small really old town of Lacock for lunch (there’s 4 options of food) and Bath. Could not see the Roman baths sadly as it was closed but I loved the trip. The charter bus was nice too. Was very surprised by the beauty of the countryside of UK.
The guide, Eugene, was excellent. Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. A long day, but all four stops were enjoyable.
Had a good experience, but the Roman bath was closed that day, they didn’t tell us this until we were on our way there , not sure what happened

A nice day of seeing some wonderful sights of England. Worth it with the following cautions.

There was a lot of confusion at Windsor with regard to whether our group had access to the tour inside the castle. While we understand that mixups like this happen, our guide Omar ended up inside the castle with that group, and those of us who did not have access were left to wander around town without a guide.

Lacock is a fabulous village well worth a visit. However, dinner at The George was terrible. I’m talking inedible. We ate a few bites only of steak and ale pie and fish and chips. They were not served hot, nor did they seem freshly prepared. I suspect they were cooked ahead of time as our orders had been called-in while we were on the road.

When the tour started out, my son and I were seated in the very back of the bus as these were the only spots remaining. This is a disadvantaged place to be. We missed some of the tour guide’s remarks a few times because we simply did not get off the bus in time. I spoke with our guide, Omar, while we were in Bath to see if it was possible to exit the bus first at the last stop, Lacock, as I was concerned about arriving at the restaurant last and not getting suitable seating. Had he explained what was to happen in Lacock (a walk of the town first) and me given a strategy to work with regarding the restaurant, everything would have been fine. Instead, Omar chose to address the situation in front of the entire group 3 times in Lacock. Before anyone disembarked the bus, he said, “The 5 people at the back of the bus have requested to get off first. Oh wait, that doesn’t make sense. Ok, never mind.” He then addressed me directly in front of the group 2 more times while in Lacock. I could not believe his lack of tact or discretion. Had he pulled me aside and spoken to me privately, there would not have been a problem. He seemed uncomfortable with my request in the first place (there was a snicker I’m quite sure), and I feel that he was deliberately trying to embarrass me while in Lacock.

So, the lessons of the day are (1) if the rest of the group is going into Windsor castle, go too so you have access to your guide, (2) don’t expect to eat well at The George, and (3) if Omar is your guide, try not to make a special request.

I would be very happy to discuss our experience with Viator/Premier Tours.
the fk just random rocks by a barbarian king st more like stonkhenge dont know why you want to go there
We had an amazing day with Kevin and Richard, travelling to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Lunch wasn't included in my tour though 😢

Pros: Very knowledgable and entertaining guide that made things much better.
Cons: "Lunch" is misleading; small snack box at best...

I thought the driver and guide did a fantastic job, but the part that frustrated us was the tour of WIndsor Castle and Stonehenge was only about hour at each location to stay on schedule for multiple stops, and we arrived in Bath after the Roman baths had closed.

This tour makes some pretty big promises, but ultimately falls short in execution. While it may seem enticing to check off so many excellent locations in a single day, especially if you are fast-paced travelers like us. Unfortunately this tour will likely leave you wishing you had done it some other way.

A few of the issues that we experienced on this tour:

1. We arrived at the bus station gate at exactly 7:45am, which was the time written on our reservation email and 15 minutes *before* the time posted on the website where we booked the tour, only to find that the coach had departed early, leaving us and 10 other passengers behind. The tour operators scrambled for about 15 minutes and managed to figure out that they could put us on another bus to Windsor, where we were able to catch up to our original tour. Unfortunately this came with a string of subtle jabs and implications that we were late, which we were NOT.

2. Our tour guide, Magnus, complained constantly throughout the day that he was forced to accommodate an "extra" 12 passengers that he hadn't originally planned on, in spite of the fact that our names were literally printed on his check-off list every time we got on the bus. This became a theme throughout the day and we felt we were constantly being blamed for somehow delaying the tour, in spite of the fact that we never once were late for a single departure time throughout the entire day. We felt very unwelcome.

3. Long bus rides between locations were mostly silent. Magnus could have filled this time giving us details and suggestions about how best to experience the upcoming attraction. (To be fair, he did some of this, but not nearly enough.) Instead, we heard over and over again how we were behind schedule and how he didn't have time to explain anything because of it. He seemed very flustered from the moment we met him and didn't seem to be able to recover.

4. The first hour of our 90 minute stop in Windsor was spent standing in line (45 min) and going through security (15 min). This left us with just 30 minutes to explore the palace, abbey, and town, which is impossible to do. You will be left wishing you had more time. Magnus also explicitly cautioned us against watching the changing of the guard due to time constraints, which was a let-down to say the least.

5. We spent 90 minutes at Stonehenge, which was just barely enough time to get out to the stones and back. We could not spend time in the visitor's center or even listening to the audio tour.

6. For us, lunch turned out to be supper, even though our booking clearly stated "lunch". It would have been helpful to know this ahead of time so we could have packed some food. Instead we had to scramble and spend 15 precious minutes of our allotted time at Stonehenge to purchase an over-priced sandwich to eat on the bus since no food, snacks or even water were provided by the tour until evening.

7. We had just 45 minutes to explore Bath, so Magnus suggested that we skip the Roman baths in interest of time, which was another let-down.

8. Dinner at the George Inn in Lacock was interesting, but we spent 30 minutes waiting for our food to come out. The food was fine, but nothing to get too excited about. The inn itself was quite interesting, but certainly not the highlight of the tour. After dinner, our departure time was delayed for an additional 15 minutes to give the driver a required break, which was confusing since we hadn't been driving for about an hour at that point. Ultimately, we would have skipped this stop in favor of spending more time in Bath.

9. We didn't get back to London until 9:30pm. This was fine for us - we expected to arrive late, but some others on the tour were apparently very distressed by the late return.

At the end of the day, we enjoyed seeing what we were able to see - that's why I gave it 2 stars. But the tour itself was executed so poorly, both by the company and by our tour guide, that we wished we had either selected a different option (maybe without lunch?), or just rented a car and done it on our own.

RECOMMENDATION: try taking the tour without the stop for lunch/supper. Hopefully, this would ease the itinerary enough that you have a bit more time at each of the major sites, which is why you are doing the tour in the first place.

This is a 12.5 hour long tour. That means if you take this tour from October thru March, you will be doing the last two stops; Lacock and Bath, in the dark. Having been to Bath in the summer, seeing it in the dark is totally pointless and not worth the time or money since you miss the beauty of the Georgian Architecture. To further our disappointment, we traveled on Boxing Day only to learn, after we departed, that many of the shops, museums, sites and restaurants at the stops were closed. This may be obvious ahead of time to Britons, but it’s not obvious to a traveler and should have been made known at the time of purchase. No discount on ticket price was offered to compensate for seeing two key tour destinations after dark nor being able to visit key points of interest while there. Consequently, the best and only noteworthy part of the twelve hour day was the one hour we spent at Stonehenge.

That being said, the trip was further made pointless due to the fact it was too big (two double decker buses filled with people) all of whom were to hear the minor factoids offered by the guide thru the single headset microphone she spoke into. With no headphones or radios you couldn’t hear a thing if you were much further back than the first two or three rows of people. The information we could hear was mostly issued over the PA system on the tour bus—but some of that information was dubious or false (“the lion, symbol of the American Republican political party”), and while these may have been only asides, they naturally introduced doubts about the credibility of the more important historical info.

The tour wrapped with a 3 hour return trip to London on a bus with a semi operational water closet.

Would not do this tour again. And will not opt for another Premium Tour.

Had a fantastic time on this trip. Ben was our tour guide and was great with local knowledge and helping us get around. You get ample time at each place to walk around and see the sights.Great driving by Ali as well!

This was a great way to see multiple sights in one day. Karen, our tour guide, was fantastic! She was obviously very experienced, and made the tour very interesting and informative. Be forewarned - it's a long day. However, we had an amazing time and would recommend this tour again!

I am extremely happy that I chose this trip. The bus was very comfortable and the ride was extremely smooth. The trip guide, Steve, was phenomenal. He has an endless an amount of small tidbits of information about all kinds of places we passed on the road. It was really entertaining and made the trip back and forth much more than just a bus ride to the the tourist sites. Plus he was great in answering any questions we had. I think I enjoyed the ride, and the ongoing narrative he gave, almost as much as the sites themselves. At the sites, he gave us all the information we needed to make the most out of each site in the time we had. I highly recommend that you book this tour and ask for Steve as your guide. You will definitely not be disappointed.

My husband and I enjoyed this trip as it provides a sample of places we would love to go back to. Premier tours does an excellent job with a fast paced itinerary. Led by our knowledgeable and entertaining guide, Leon, and by our fearless driver, Abdul, we were whisked away to a journey through the english countryside to see the Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. A short lunch in the charming town of Lacock was a perfect moment to rest and engage with other people on the tour. This was a fun way to spend Thanksgiving! Thank you Tour 79!

We booked this very last minute (the night before). We aren't group tour folks but this was so worth it. A packed day but Peter James was outstanding. Kept us on task, was so thoughtful and informative! Couldn't think of a better way to get in multiple sights.

Wonderful full day tour of three outstanding attractions. Guide Peter James was above and beyond with commentary on the attractions an much more. He provided caring personal service.
Putnams
The tour is about 13 hours with lots of walking. Great tour. Would recommend it. Our guide was very knowledgeable and considerate of our needs (when to buy food and toilet breaks).

It was a good tour and the guide was knowledgable. He did warn us when we started out that there was a lot packed in this tour. The last place on the tour was Bath. We arrived too late to see the Roman Baths and they were closed, which was disappointing. So we walked around the city. The lunch was good but they only had one waitress delivering 3 dishes at a time. I am sure that slowed us down. It still was a great way to tour the area.

We were pleasantly surprised at how smoothly this tour went, Pepe was a great tour guide, so informative & engaging & torguay a safe and friendly driver. Some said there was not enough time at the places and it was quick, and as we arrived late in Bath, everything to see was closing, but it was still a great day tour and worthwhile.
Mad stones fam. Best walk Ive had, was a mission from the car but hey, how did they get those stones up?

Overall the trip for myself, my husband and our friends was Great! Clarissa was our guide and Manuel was our bus driver. Clarissa said right from the start don't be late or she will leave you. and that is exactly what she did to 2 people at he end of our tour at Stonehenge. I thought she said to be back at the bus at 6:30 pm, but for some reason I think she said 6:15, at 6:24 she told the bus driver to leave and left 2 people behind!! I think she should have waited 6 more minutes. I am just happy we were back around 6:20 cause I always like to be early!

Eugene our tour guide along with Carlos, our driver, were awesome! This tour is so educational, and full of sights. Eugene is very knowledgeable and was quite entertaining. He added a lot to the sights that we were seeing. Be prepared for a long day since this is outside of London and a lot of riding. But the countryside is beautiful to see as you ride! The pub lunch was good and service outstanding! We definitely want to visit the UK again and visit the countryside again!

The tour guide is very friendly and not try to overload you with the history of each stop, do offer more information to people into history. Time at each stop is a little tight, but good enough if you only in London for few days. However, there is no WiFi on the bus as they advertised, and you will be left behind if you’re not on time. Recommend get the pub food and entrance to the castle, even get to watch the change of guard.

This was a wonderful way to see 3 key sites in one day. Myself, my husband and our 15 year old son thoroughly enjoyed the 3 sites (Bath, Windsor and Stonehenge). Beautiful architecture and amazing history. Our guide, Clive and driver, Carlos were THE BEST we have experienced. The tour was well organized, and went very smoothly.

So why not 5 stars? One word - Lacock. Wasted stop, nothing to see and a terrible, almost inedible meal (we ordered one of each - sausages, fish & chips, cottage pie). All BAD. My cold, dried up sausages and chips came without any condiments. They must have been made at breakfast and been reheated when Clive let them know we were approaching. A complete waste of time that could have been wonderfully spent in Bath, which would have put lunch at lunchtime (instead of 3:30) and given us loads of choices for food and/or more time for shopping or seeing the actual baths, etc.

Our “11 hour” tour got us back in 13 hours. A very long day, but a lot of beautiful ground covered. Our exceptional guides became friends and it was quite a relaxed and comfortable trip.

I’d still recommend the tour (be sure to board Clive’s bus); but strongly suggest Premium Tours drop the pub stop (no matter what they are paying you to get the traffic there). If they don't change it, pick up food to go in Bath and just order a Cider at the pub - that was actually quite good.

Cheers

This tour remarkably gets you to four different sites in the course of one day. It operates like a well oiled machine. Eugene is a terrific guide, both knowledgeable and friendly and Carlos is bus driver extraordinare! As for the venues, Stonehenge speaks for itself and Lacock is charming. Bath was fun to walk around and the Abbey is beautiful if you choose not to see the Roman Baths. That being said, the amount of time spent at each site is limited. For those like me who love architecture and art, you may feel as if you are a bit rushed at Windsor. But life is a trade off. Go it alone, wait in lines to buy tickets, take your life in your hands driving a rental car through London and it’s outskirts and spend more time, or make your life simple and take this tour seeing the countryside while relaxing on a comfortable tour bus with great commentary. To me, it’s a no brainer! Take this tour! Thanks for a wonderful day!

I want to start off by saying our guide, Eugene, and our driver, Carlos, were hilarious and a treat to be with! We truly feel lucky to have had them for our tour.

This experience was amazing! I am traveling with 4 companions and we all enjoyed the trip thoroughly. We left Victoria Coach Station and spent a couple of hours in Windsor Castle, although about 30 mins was spent waiting for the gates. However, our guide Eugene filled the time spectacularly with his knowledge of the area and the history of the castle and royals. He was a delight to listen to!

After Windsor, we left for Stonehenge, which happened to include the audio tour as well. The pub lunch in Lacock was satisfying (choice of cottage pie (meat & potato), fish & chips, sausage & chips, or mushroom risotto (vegetarian)). The town of Lacock was adorable with many local businesses selling all sorts of soaps, preserves, breads, and even Harry Potter souvenirs!

The city of Bath was the last stop, which had so much to see! There were only a couple of hours remaining, but it’s a place you could spend all day in, to be honest. It took about 2.5 hours to drive back to London, plenty of time to rest your eyes. We were given option to be dropped off near the Gloucester Road station or Victoria station at the end, which was nice.

Eugene gave many recommendations for places to eat and see. I only wish that there was a pamphlet or sheet with the names/addresses so it would be easier for us to find.

Tips: This is an all day experience (7:30am - 8:00pm). Wear comfortable shoes, you will still do a fair bit of walking. Do NOT be late back to the bus, they will leave anyone that is late by more than a few minutes, but this is to ensure we all have enough time at each of the stops. Children are welcome on the tour. Lunch was at a later time (around 3:30pm) but there are places to get snacks/drinks at each stop.

David our tour guide and Abdul were both great on the day. Could not say enough about them both. David was full of information and knowledge amazing really. For our first time overseas it was great. A long day but worth it.

Windsor Castle was wonderful, Bath and Stonehenge such a great experience.
Thank you for a great trip and for making the day such a time that we will always remember.

Sue & Leo Jordan
Australia

We did the Stonehenge, Windsor and Bath with Pub lunch tour today. Tom was very informative and gave us many details about the areas we were visiting. Turgay was a great driver. He made the trip very comfortable and we were on time for all of our tours. Thank you Tom and Turgay.

The tour was very nice, though I think it could have been organized a little better. All you have is a booking number, not even a ticket. It's incredibly busy at the station and you don't have an exact location of where to go, you just go to their gate range (I think we were in gates 19-22) and ask someone. We left from Victoria Station in London, and we ended up on the wrong bus. We asked many Premium tours employees, and they all pointed us in a direction but no one actually looked at our booking to tell us where exactly to go, so we got on the wrong bus. It worked out, we managed to meet up with our correct tour at Windsor Castle, but I feel like they could avoid a lot of these issues by having tickets, checking tickets and just being more organized all together

Someone in our tour group fell at Windsor castle (NOT her fault.. I am not blaming her) and we had to wait for over an hour while they were filing a police report before we could head to the next location. We thought we would miss something on the itinerary, but we ended up just having to shuffle things around a bit. We had to move our lunch to more of an early dinner, which was frustrating because everyone was starving at this point. Plus, we didn't get as much time at Bath or Stonehenge because we were so behind. It was frustrating, but the company did manage to fit everything in so I'll give them that.

If you are worried about not getting enough time at a certain place you're looking forward to, make sure you book the trip without the lunch. You stop in multiple places that have food you can buy and the tour group isn't on as much of a strict schedule because they don't have to be at lunch at a specific time. Though, the little town you have lunch in is really cute. The lunch is good as well.
Our guide Andrew was excellent. Very funny and very knowledgeable. We got to see a lot in one day. The only downside was not quite enough time in Windsor. Overall, I would highly recommend this tour.
Great trip was on time, saw lots of places had enough time at Stonehenge. We would have like to have stayed longer in Bath. All in all it was a Great tour.

This was a jam packed tour and we loved every minute! There was so much to see and do!! Windsor Castle was amazing - so much history. Lunch in Lacock was fantastic, which was followed by a walking tour through town - very interesting. Stonehenge was incredible also. The whole day was great - I would definitely recommend the tour!

We did the tour today of Windsor, Bath & Stonehenge with a stop off for lunch at Lacock. The tour guide Peter was excellent, very attentive and knowledgeable. He, along with the bus driver Vanett (I hope that’s how you spell it) were very considerate of ensuring we had the best day whilst being efficient with time. Vanett’s driving was nice and easy, which was great as I often get motion sickness but not today! I thought the tour was highly organised, for those whom complain that it’s too rushed: it’s important to know before you book that that is a highlights tour. There will be a degree of rushing as you are trying to fit three major attractions into one day, which the tour operators do very well. There are others who complain of being left behind if late, which is just an unfair complaint as you are advised many times that this is a possibility. The guide stresses the time to get back to the location as well as the fact that you must not be late, so these kind of people need to get better at their time management I think. The tour was awesome, couldn’t have wished for more

We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Premium Coach tours. Tours may have been rushed but we were happy we got to see 4 locations in one day and still able to get in and out the souvenir shops. Lunch in Lacock yum 😋 Ben was our lovely guide and Andre was our driver, he was lovely too and got us there and back safe. Both very funny and helpful. We hope you guys get the kudos you both deserve because you were both wonderful! Alison and Phil.

I loved this tour! You get to see 3 different places in one day! Windsor castle is absolutely stunning. The knowledge of the history that our tour leader shared was incredible. The highlight of the trip was Stonehenge! You are given an audio device and at each significant point you can hear a description of what you are looking at. It’s breathtaking! I definitely recommend this tour!

I felt our Premium Bus Tour to Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath, and Lacock was very thoughtfully planned. Yes, it was a brisk pace - but we were still able to absorb the beautiful locations. And the countryside on the way to the sights was stunning! Our tour guide, Tom, gave us thorough, engaging historical backgrounds. And Valdette, our driver was super skilled.

We only had 3 days in Great Britain and this tour was perfect! We got to see so much! You don’t get a ton of time at the sights but enough that you get to see it all! The tour guide Omar was great and really made it an enjoyable experience!

At the beginning, I was’t very happy about the way people gathered at the meeting point of Premium agents in Victoria coach station. But as soon as we entered the coach I have changed my mind. The driver Abdu is very professional and kind. Our guide Eugene is the best tour guide I have ever met in my life. Very informative and has a sense of humor. I didn’t miss a word of his explanation because of his way of attracting our attention. The sites we visited were really nice and although other reviews complained of shortage of time, I found it very enough at each site but wished the entrance of the Roman bath was included with this lovely trip. We had a great lunch at a small charming town called Lacock at the George Inn. The final stop of our trip was at the Stonehenge an amazing cultural site. All places were well chosen. The whole duration of the trip was about 12:30 hrs but with such great places visited and such an amazing tour guide with a professional driver time passed so quick with lots of fun.

This tour was one day filled with amazing sites. It is a full day, but well worth it. Plenty of time to tour Windsor Castle, which is incredible. The city of Bath is so charming I wish we had more time to spend there. Stonehenge is a must see - what an incredible sight. Finishing up the tour with a meal at a very cool pub. Eugene was our guide and he was very knowledgeable! There are no bathrooms on the Bus (saw this question several times) But, there is plenty of opportunities to use the Loo at all the stops. Highly recommend this tour!

Visited Windsor, Bath, Lacock and Stonehenge - it was a full/ long day but so worth it. Carol was a lovely tour guide; full of knowledge and very willing to answer questions and help. Bus driver was also great. Coach bus was comfortable, no wifi as noted online but not a huge issue for me. I wasn’t a fan of the lunch in Lacock but it’s likely due to personal preference- pre ordered a glass of wine and the glass was filthy (not a Premium Tours issue). Lots of free time at each stop even with it being a busy day of activities. Very glad I chose this trip.

First, our guide, Gavin, was wonderful! He really should have his own tour company and not work for someone - he is a gem and made a very poorly planned day much better. He is knowledgable and patient.

If you aren't familiar with big bus tours, DO NOT make this your first experience. It is not well thought out at all. Your day begins with absolute chaos at Victoria Coach Station. There is no organization whatsoever and it's a horrible way to begin a long, expensive day. You'll get to your gate along with at least 10 other tour groups. The groups are 60+, so you're basically listening for your tour number to be shouted out, then it's a race to the bus so you don't lose sight of your guide. They really should stagger departure times or gates to avoid this. People pushing and shoving, strollers and children walked over. Just really set the day off on a bad tone.

Once on board the bus, we found out the toilet wasn't working and wouldn't be fixed. Traveling with 4 seniors and being quite pregnant, this was just unfortunate. There was no wifi on board the coach as is advertised.

We drove to Windsor and waited in line about 30 minutes. Garvin gave a great history of the area and castle. We made our way inside to another 15 minute wait to get through security. We were told we really couldn't miss the state apartments or the chapel. We ended up with about 20 minutes in the state apartments and did not get to the chapel before needing to return to the bus. We did get to see part of the changing of the guard on our way back to the bus, which was great. We stopped at Eat and picked up sandwiches to eat on the bus, but did not have time to eat before re-boarding.

Re-boarded the bus and headed to Stonehenge. Again, we had about 20 minutes at the stones by the time the shuttle dropped us off there. I'd been before so it was fine, but the 4 with us had not and it wasn't even enough time to walk completely around them before standing in line for the shuttle again. We did not have time to visit the visitor center or gift shop.

We enjoyed our time in Bath. Had just about an hour to wander the town. A note that entrance to the Roman Baths is NOT included in this tour. One lady on our bus was very upset and claimed she had been told entry was included. If you want entrance to the baths you'll need to book a different tour. We visited a couple of the shops and had a snack before meeting back at the bus.

Lunch in Lacock was fine, but we wished we'd done the tour without the lunch stop to allow more time at the other stops. There are plenty of places to eat in Bath, or even take a snack with you. We were at the pub in Lacock for over an hour and had a bit of a walk through the town before boarding the bus.

Overall for this 12 hour day, we were on the bus for 8+ hours to be off the bus at the sights for just over 3 hours. Had we really thought about what that would look like and how little time we would have, we'd have chosen a different tour for sure. Again, Garvin our guide was EXCELLENT and did the best he could within the limits of the tour. But the tour itself was far less of a tour and far more of a foot race to get a glimpse of the sights and race back to the bus. :(

Fantastic tour!!!! Our guide (Ben) and driver (Richard) are the Best! They got us in before crowds and we had plenty of time to enjoy the sights . Ben was very knowledgeable and told great jokes. Everyone enjoyed the day! We are a family of 5 from Coral Springs Florida . Highly recommend this tour and team Ben and Richard

Do not book this tour. Were told on the way it was going to be a race to get in. We walked forever no time to use the toilet. Waited in line before Castle opened for 30 min. Then we waited in line inside for another 30 minutes to clear security. Picked up hand held tour guide tablet with no instructions. My wife’s was set on Russian. Walked another 10 min. Had to use toilet by then . Finally we got to entrance line to the state apartments and it was another 30 min wait so we had to go back because we had to be on bus by 10:40 am or were going to be locked inside and would be left there with no way back . Had to go to security to be escorted out the way we had come in at great embarrassment. RUSH LINES WAIT WAIT WAIT NO BREAKS FOR RESTROOM TOILET AND SAW NOTHING. Even those that managed to get in were only in the castle for 30 minutes. Double decker bus over 60 people impossible to hear the guide when we were able to stay with the group. Guide did best she could but their management should not plan a tour with this many people and plan to have you wait 4 times longer than the visit and not even get into the castle was inexcusable . For This tour company it is all about $$$$ and zero consideration as to what is proper.

My husband and I took this tour in June 2019 and absolutely loved it. Ricardo was our driver and safely navigated tight English roads. Leon was our guide and was highly entertaining and informative. He made the long drives between stopping points very enjoyable and we learned so much about British history! We had such a great time, enjoyed the others on the tour, and lunch in Lacock, as well as the sights in Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge. Would highly recommend this tour and you'll be extra lucky if you get Leon as your guide!

This was a wonderful, long day. We did have to queue at Windsor Castle so the view time wasn’t very long unfortunately. Bath was interesting- full of history. Lacock was the highlight for me - very old village unchanged over time. Picture thatched rooftops. Lunch in the pub was average but a lovely experience. Of course Stonehenge was interesting and mysterious. Our guide Andrew and driver were informative and thorough.

Very long day but our guide did a great job of giving us breaks to nap on the comfortable bus. We got to see a lot! Drove through the beautiful countryside. WiFi didn’t work on the bus but wasn’t really missed.

We really enjoyed this trip it’s nice way to see a lot in a few days. My dad really enjoyed it, my only thing is a lot of the time it felt rushed for me specifically with The Windsor Castle part, we did not have time to see the state apartments. But the cathedral was awesome. It’s just due to a lack of time. But we had a blast.

Buy your tickets for Windsor castle ahead of time. We didn’t and had to wait in line. You will only be able to see the exterior of the castle if you don’t get a ticket. There are shops and things to do around there though if you want to skip that part.

This trip was well worth the price. Locating the Victoria coach station was a little awkward, but once there and in the bus, things were fabulous.

Ben (guide) and Abdul J (coach driver) were wonderful hosts and made the best of situations when guests missed bus boarding times and did their best to keep things on schedule.

All stops allowed for us to quickly see the highlights of each location, all while enjoying the English countryside. Next trip to London will definitely include another tour!

We booked the Saturday May 25 tour of Stonehenge, Windsor and Bath with Pub Lunch in Lacock. We had an AWESOME guide who reminded us of Trevor Noah; very entertaining and naturally funny ! left at 8 am and returned to drop off by 730 pm or so. Saturday traffic was quite manageable. We had no significant crowds at Windsor Castle or Stonehenge. We did NOT enjoy visit to Bath ... too commercialized with very little of actual interest. Lunch at Lacock was excellent !
Recommend that you book a trip that AVOIDS Bath portion, to get additional time at Windsor Castle or Stonehenge. We were the last group to visit Stonehenge ... we appreciated because the crowds were small. Wifi and bathrooms on bus were A-1 100% !! ps keep your eyes open as you travel thru countryside; you will see pheasants and foxes

The tour was almost a 13 hour day from start to finish. Buses were clean and comfortable and our tour guide was quite helpful and entertaining. We went from Windsor to Stonehenge, to Bath, and ended in LaCock for dinner at the Pub. My only disappointment was that I would have preferred to stay a bit longer at Windsor and Bath. Stonehenge was perfect and the dinner at the end of the day was a great, small meal but well done. Would highly recommend. The only difficult part was getting to the bus station so early in the morning. All in all - was a great way to see the cities,

My kids and I took this tour last Tuesday! It was a wonderful experience at each stop. The pub we ate at felt like we went back in time and I didn't want to leave! The bus was very comfortable.Our guide was Tom, and he was very friendly and funny :)

My family & I spent the day on a bus tour going to Windsor, Bath, Laycock & Stonehenge. We had a fantastic time!
We had Eugène for our tour guide. His commentary was very informative & entertaining. Thanks for showing us Prof Slughorn’s house in Laycock! Our HP loving family appreciates finding this hidden gem in the quiet UK country side!
Kudos to our driver Morris for some outstanding driving in the narrow country lanes & the congested streets of London!
We have 4 choices to choose from for lunch. My kids liked the fish & chips. I had the meat pie with carrots & peas, slathered with rich gravy, which I really enjoyed. My husband had the sausage & chips. He thought the sausage was a good.
As with any MULTI-site tour, time in each venue is pretty tight, but again, not unexpected since you’re trying to see several sites in 1 day. I thought that the allotted time allowed us to see the more important points of each site & serves as great INTRO to each location.
I feel that the tour went well for us since it allowed our family to get out of the hustle & bustle of London, and allowed our kids (aged 8 & 10) to escape, what to them is, the monotony of seeing museum after museum after museum.
All in all, a great way to spent a day.

Overall it was a nice trip, wish we can spend more time at Bath and Windsor. The lunch was okay, not as good as I thought it would be... the menu consists of 4 choices of food, fish n chips, sausage n fries, veg risotto and cottage pie. I wish i had chosen the one without the lunch so we can spend more time somewhere else

I stayed in London for a week and took a day-long excursion in this bus tour. Our guide was Gavin and the driver was James. They were great. Gavin was the most enthusiastic and fun guide I have ever met- assuming that he repeatedly leads this trip many times, he genuinely cared that we had a great time and was very personable, and so funny. He was still telling a lot of stories at the end of the 12 hour trip enthusiastically and even after we got off the bus and were waiting for a ride, he personally approached us to ask if we are ok. Thank you Gavin for being such a caring guide. I hope we see you again in one of your tours!
London was exciting over all, and this tour definitely made the visit to the country very memorable, and we got to taste various faces of England that were all interesting in different ways. I personally wish we had had more time to stay on the ground of Stonehenge, just because the landscape was so beautiful. Highly recommended!

We are so glad we chose this tour! It was a long day but from beginning to end our tour guide Gavin made it enjoyable and informative. The bus ride itself, with driver James, was a beautiful tour of the English country side. We particularly liked the great mix of group time and free time we had to explore on our own. And Gavin (with a G!) was an excellent host, friendly, funny, knowledgeable and attentive! Don’t miss this tour!

We don’t usually do official tours, but our time in the UK was limited, so this tour appealed as a way to see a lot in a short time. Our tour guide, Lucy, was the best: she provided background information and helpful tips, and she kept things on schedule. Amazingly, she managed to be firm but kind. My kids (ages ranging from 12 to 27) enjoyed this tour, as the pace kept their parents from bogging down too much. If I had it to do over, I would take a slightly slower pace as I walked through Windsor Castle: that was our first step, and we went a bit too quickly; also, I’d do as Lucy suggested: buy some sandwiches in the town and eat them on the bus so that you can savor every minute in Windsor. We had beautiful blue skies the day we toured Stonehenge; I loved Bath—we opted for the Roman bath museum, but one of my sons chose to walk around town instead—and Lacock was absolutely charming. Looking at my photos from that day, we were relaxed and happy because Lucy and Andreas, our driver, were doing all the thinking for us.

This activity was amazing, Windsor Castle was spectacular, the little towns were quaint a lot shops and restaurants, Stonehenge was beautiful.
Our tour guide Andrew was the best so funny and knowledgeable. I definitely recommend this trip 👍🏼

Truly enjoyed this tour because our Tour Guide Gavin was so knowledgeable and funny. He knew his subject and incorporated humor. What a way to learn history! I truly recommend this tour . request for Gavin and Nunu.

Peter was a fantastic tour guide. He provided just the right level of information, tips and interesting stories. My 12 year old son and I throughly enjoyed visit. I have taken many bus tours around the world - this was one of the best.

This is super big group.. double decker bus full. Without any earpiece to hear to the guide. The guide keep on shouting back n forward. This just ridiculously stupid. While other tours have earpiece and can listen to the guide. Worst tour i follow ever

This was an incredible experience to visit such iconic places. Our tour leader (forgive me, as i can't recall her name 🙁) was exceptional! Funny, knowledgeable, kind, hospitable, professional, and went out of her way to ensure we were all looked after. This will always be a beautiful memory for me. Stonehenge was where my fiance Mark proposed to me!!!

I recommend this trip to everyone! You will gain a wealth of knowledge, take loads of photos, and create memories that will last a life time!!!

John, our guide was great! Due to the bus issue that was beyond our control, we all missed the Stonehenge tour- but that was forgivable because of our guide's passion to deliver the best tour for the group.
Windsor was amazing! Sadly, photography was not allowed in the interior of the Castle, but feel free to selfie in the castle's grounds. Be awed by how the old royalties lived and the Royalties now live their privileged lives. You don't have to worry about getting hungry because there are restaurants along with windsor castle, there's even a Burger King! And for teacup collectors, you can buy your set inside Windsor. Somehow, it makes the purchase, royalty official :)
The City of Bath was wonderful! We did not buy tickets for the Roman Bath (Roman Bath ticket is not included in the tour, you have to purchase the ticket onsite), instead- we opted to walk around the city. Don't forget to try the Cornish pastry at the Cornish Bakery, I highly recommend either the Steak or the Traditional.
Our Pub lunch at George Inn was great. I had Fish and Chips. The fish was very crispy. The lady owner of the Inn, though, was...well- she has her peculiar attitude. She needs to chill and be more customer service oriented :)

First off great staff. JR AND STEVE M did an amazing job. We did have a few bumps with this tour more to do with people but our guide kept us on time.
We had a new bus but we had no Wi-Fi which was included disappointing. Our first stop was Windsor Castle we got there and had great time and missed the long line due to the bank holiday the driving was superior and the banter from Steve was great unfortunately one of our bus mates was late getting back to the bus so we departed late. we did not get to stop in Lacock we moved onto a different pub would’ve loved to of stopped in Lacock as it was beautiful. The tour of Stonehenge was amazing but again someone was late getting back to the bus so we departed late again onto Bath nice drive to Bath we arrived in time so that people could go in to the Roman baths before it closed but I found The town very dirty at the end of the day We drove in walked around drove out. If I was to do again I would skip Bath.
The staff did amazing with what they were dealing with and I am using them again.

I booked this tour on their office in Chiswick, staff were polite and nice, very accomodating.

Now on the tour day, We came from Victoria tube, walked 6mins to Victoria coach station. The gate for pick up is packed with people that booked premium tours, london tour, england in 1 day, stonehenge tour, etc. But it is organized enough and all queries asked by many guests were answered clearly and nicely. Depart time is on time.

We did the tour with Steve, the guide, he us very informative, with slight humor which is enough because most guest sleeps along the drive anyway. Our driver is Dexter Leander, special mention! I call him "Dexter my friend my brother" he is nice and polite, u can tell. And drives smoothly.

All the tour is great, seeing Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, Bath (roman baths-needs to buy ticket there) and Lacock. Steve gave all information and history you need, definitely worth mentioning them. Steve and Dexter.

I highly recommend. Long day, but definitely worth it, it is amazing tour.

Thanks Premium tours!
From Jose

First of all I would like to say our tour guide Eugene, and our bus driver Carlos were both amazing! Eugene was super funny and has a world of knowledge, Carlos is an excellent driver getting us to our destinations safe and on time!
Our first stop was Windsor Castle, an amazing place just wish we could have had more time there. Second stop was Stonehenge, it was very cool to see and we had plenty of time there. The third stop was the town of Bath, instead of walking around town we decided to tour the Roman baths and glad we did. So much history to take in. Before heading back to London we stopped for an excellent dinner in the small village of Lacock.
Our bus had a mechanical issue but Eugene, Carlos, and the tour company worked everything out and our tour never skipped a beat. Great job on everyone's part! I would highly recommend this tour!!!

We had a great time on this tour, our guide Lucy was very knowledgeable & friendly.
I am purchasing this tour for my Step dad who is visiting next month.
No pics from Stonehenge, phone died as we were pulling in.
Fantastic tour. Lasted about 13 hours but it was well worth it. Our driver and tour guide, Martin and Leon, were excellent. Very knowledgeable and made the long day enjoyable.

If you don't like long couch rides, this isn't the tour for you. We loved it and the pub food was great too. The company was on time and the couch was clean. The tour guide was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating. The bus driver was drove safely and efficient to every stop. Our first tour of many and hope they are as good as this was.
This was very good but too rushed, especially in Bath. Lacock was the best stop besides Stonehenge. Check that one off the bucket list 👍

We spent the entire day on this tour - starting at 7:45a.m. and ending about 8:30pm - but it was organized so well that it wasn't even tiring! We really had a great day and we have to give that to our guide, "Irish" John and our driver Nuno. Both of these guys were incredible! John filled much of our time with great stories of history and information about the areas we traveled and Nuno's driving was nothing short of amazing. They were an incredible team and we feel fortunate to have had them in charge of our day.

As you might expect on a day filled with such tremendous sites, we didn't get very long at any place but Irish John and Nuno made sure we got all the time we could in each. We were the very first coach at Windsor, the first group in line! In Bath, John explained clearly the best use of our time. Lacock was so incredibly well organized. We enjoyed a traditional pub lunch and were then treated to the highlights of this charming town established around 1230 - and John is so creative, funny and interesting! Then we were off to Stonehenge where Nuno and John managed to get some extra time to enjoy the stone circle, the museum, the interactive area and have time for a coffee or snack.

We had a marvelous day! John and Nuno were icing on the cake! Highly recommended just not enough hours in a day.

Like some other reviewers, I found the tour felt rushed. Where I appreciated being able to see multiple sites, the time allotted at each was minimal, especially Bath. Our tour guide, Gavin made sure we were at the front of the line to get in to Windsor which was nice, but it felt like we spent more time in queue than enjoying the sites. Wifi on the bus was non existent- one of the reasons we chose this tour was specifically for that so that was very disappointing.
Gavin and Nuno were great. Kind, funny and shared good information.

This was a great day adventure, around the beautiful English country-side, and I want to thank the guide Eugene and the driver Carlos for being top-notch! For anyone booking this tour who is not familiar with London, give yourself more than plenty of time to figure out how to get to the Victoria Bus station, as it's down the street and across the road from Victoria tube station - head towards the white clock tower and then look across the street! Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath and Lacock is a lot to see in one day - so you don't really have much time in each spot - with the crowds, as I went on a Sunday, but it was a great day all around - Eugene is an incredible guide, always willing to answer questions, or help out in any way. Carlos is an excellent driver, and together the two of them made a really nice pair. One thing to keep in mind at Stonehenge is that it's a 30 minute walk from the Visitor Centre to the stones, or you can wait in line and take a bus. If you have more time, I would recommend walking because then you can see some of the other sites to Stonehenge, because the bus line up was quite long, although it will give you more time at the main stones- which are very crowded. This stop on the tour seemed a bit rushed, as by the time I waited in line for the bus to take me to Stonehenge, then walked around and took some pictures, and then got the bus back to the Visitor Centre, I was out of time, so did not have any lunch - I would recommend packing some water and snacks at least! Bath is quite beautiful, and lovely, and the Roman baths are very interesting - having seen the original Roman baths in Italy, this was very interesting to me from a historical point of view. Eugene is very knowledgeable about Bath and shared some unique highlights, great little places to eat (the Cornish pasty was divine, and I got to try a Scotch Egg too), and then more driving to Lacock which was both interesting and nice to have dinner and a drink in the pub, and meet some of my fellow passengers. This trip is a full day adventure, and I would highly recommend it. Wear comfortable shoes, and pack some snacks and you'll have a great time.

We had a great experience with our tour with Leon. We did the pub lunch in Laycock as well and it was quite worth it. Yes it was a bit hurried but you were seeing four different venues in one day. The information and history shared with the group added so much value. The bus was clean and comfortable. There were four choices for lunch. The directions of what one could see in each spot and how and when to return to the bus were clear/. It was all in all quite exceptional.

Steve M the tour guide was really good and I tipped him well.
Other then that, not very impressed.
Started the day with harsh words from the staff about bringing a beverage onboard... really, in their day and age, I think any responsible adult can handle a “take away” cup of coffee on a buss. Not impressed.
The quality of the bus is not as described. The bus is anything but premium. Space at each seat has been reduced to cram on more guests on the bus. NO recline in seats.
Wife that was advertised on the website was not functional. When I asked the driver he was “ ya, it doesn’t really work”...
2. To me, the the trip is poorly planned out. More driving then touring. Honestly felt like the day was mostly tailored to the Lacock lunch. Skip the Lackok lunch and skip Stonehenge - allowing for adequate time at Windsor Castle and adequate time in Bath would be more realistic.
Certainly not worth the $ 400 CDN after the exchange rate for my wife and I.

Would not recommend.

Went with 2 other friends to London for 4days and we really wanted to go to stonehenge so we decided to try this day tour (March 28, 2019). Thanks to our guide Leon for informing us regarding the history of England, he is very passionate about his work and i learned so much.
Our first stop was Windsor castle, then Stonehenge. We had a late (free) lunch 3pm at Lacock then we headed to Bath. Roman bath tickets are not included, but you can get a discount if you are a student (just show student id when buying tix).
Overall great experience.

The tour was very nice, landscapes breathtaking, lots of interesting information, the bus was comfortable and we were back early enough for dinner.However, if you're like me, that likes taking your time, strolling around, listening to audio guides... this isn't for you. You only stay in each place for about one hour. In Stonehenge, it was enough, but I would've liked to spend more time in the other areas.
Lunch wasn't too big and it was pretty late, so be ready with snacks or a heavy breakfast to keep until 15h. Also, not all options were typical English, as I expected.
Our guide was very helpful and kind at all times (I think her name is Carole, but not sure) The stop at Bath was actually too long, basically to go to the restroom before heading back, as there isn't a great lot to see there.
Dave and Carlos were amazing! Dave was very engaging and informative all say long while Carlos kept the coach running smoothly. Full on day but well worth the time!

This was an excellent, full days journey. David was our guide and together with his driver, they did an amazing job. The coach was a new double decker and was perfect for our needs as our group consisted of 66 people. I would definitely recommend this tour.

This tour is a great way to fit in all of these amazing sights in one day, with a great guide. Each stop allowed for independent time to explore what interested you the most. So glad we chose this option!

Our tour Guide was Lucy, Drivers were Anthony and Lee. Very Efficient. exactly the service I expected for this expensive tour. very information, laid back but organized. lots of good facts and the way back to the city, they make to drop off stops which were very convenient for my sister and I. it is expensive but for a first timer to London, I would recommend.

Having been a Greyhound driver during the summer's in my college days I know what it takes to handle a coach safely. Unfortunately, I don't believe that "Dennis" did. He pulled out in front of cars at round-abouts that would have cleared ten seconds later, failed to use signals and ran a yellow light three times. Our tour guide bascially just read from a manual. We were delivered to Windsor 50 minutes before it openned so we stood outside in 20 degree weather waiting while later tours went almost straight in...so much for paying for access. Then we had to leave almost immediately and barely had time to walk through the state apartments. Having said all that, Stonehedge is a must visit in your life. Food in Lacock was pretty good. We took Evan Evans tours the next day to Warwick etc and they were much more polished and professional.

This tour is really good for travelers who have limited time and want to get to all three sites (Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath) in one day. This is definitely a highlights tour, you only spend an hour or two at each site and spend most of your time traveling between sites on the bus. The bus was nice, roomy, and clean. Our tour guide, Julie, and bus driver, Carlos, were really nice and professional. Julie was knowledgeable about every site and also good at keeping our large group on track. She was organized and kept everything on schedule.
My only complaint is the lunch. We specifically booked a tour with a lunch so we wouldn't have to worry about spending part of our sightseeing time getting food, but that's exactly what happened. Our "lunch" was at the end of the tour, around 6pm. And we weren't told how late our "lunch" was going to be until the very morning of the tour when we were already on the bus. So we had to spend part of our time in Windsor buying food to eat on the bus. If I'd known this ahead of time we would have booked the tour without lunch so we could get back to London earlier and have dinner there at our leisure.
Comfortable coach, knowledgeable tour guide, quick stops and clear directions made for a fun day trip.

Not to be daunted by the early start to the day, checked in at the Premium pickup at 7.15 am. The early start is arranged to get you to the front of the queue at Windsor castle, task completed but failed to book the weather gods to stop the rain. Enjoyed seeing all that history and finery at its best.
Stonehenge was magnificent, weather gods were on the war path again.
Lacock for late lunch was set in a 14th century hotel, ambience and food were matched by the friendly service.
Bath was our next stop, Christmas markets were fantastic, time was limited and could have stayed longer but that is a different tour.

Lucy was our guide and Richard our driver, both were excellent. Lucy organised the tour well, everything was explained and the rules laid down, we adhered to them and the whole day went off without any delays, we got to see everything and Lucy guided us the whole way.

This tour really is the "highlight tour". Great places to visit. Nice coach. Very knowledgable guide - Steve was great.
A few tiny issues. Not enough time at each place, but that is the nature of the tour. And, the wait for an hour outside Windsor Castle was not super fun.

Please read the whole review.
Absolutely amazing tour. This is a steal and a great bang for your buck. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Timely and efficient travel. The best fish and chips I had in London and I had that every meal. The countryside is beautiful and so much history provided while traveling from the staff. My only complaint is that the Baths tour was not included and that may be stated somewhere in the description, however, I was under the impression that it was. Please reword so that this is clear. Also, I wish there was about 30 more minutes at each location. But I doubt it is possible, this is a full day. You really only miss out on the gift shops. Not that big of a deal if you go in knowing what you want. Again a must do.
The tour was rush but still worth to go. Danxia (Tour guide) and Micheal (Driver).did a good job! Danxia is quite knowledgeable and we enjoyed her guide very much!

Tour was a FULL day (about 12 hours), however, it didn't feel like. The driving was well spaced and not bad between sights. We saw Windsor, Stonehenge (Must see), Bath and lunch in Lacock. I think out of all of them Stonehenge was my favorite only because of the stories behind the building of Stonehenge, the Who, What, Where and Why. I could have done without the Bath portion, although it was still quit interesting hearing the history behind it. Tour guide was very knowledgeable and answered all questions that the group had as well as her own insight into each of the stops.

This is a great tour!
I would recommend arriving at least half an hour before departure as Victoria coach station is packed with people and it is not trivial to figure out where and when the tour will depart. This tour has amazing sites, but very short stops. Windsor and Stonehenge stops had more or less reasonable duration. The Bath stop was at the end of the day, plus we were stuck in a traffic jam for good half an hour, so I only had about 30 minutes to get through the Roman Baths. The lunch was actually a dinner served almost at 6pm. All of these are minor issues compared to the enjoyment of the tour.

You meet the tour company at the Victoria Coach station, not the close by Victoria train station. Meet near gate 19. Be there by 7:30 for this tour as the coach leaves at 7:45am. We grabbed the two seats up top at the front window for a great view. First stop was the castle. Be sure to mark some landmarks so you can find your way back to the coach. You have about an hour and a half to wander on your own. Start at the very top and work your way back down. There are stores and several restaurants on your way back to the coach. Next stop is Stonehenge. Again you have a little over an hour to wonder on your own which is plenty of time. By the coach is a gift store and snack shop. You do. It eat at the pub until 3:00 so you might want to grab a snack. Also the bus does not furnish any water so you may want to grab a bottle. By now your guide on the bus will have taken your order for the pub and called it in so it is ready when you arrive. There were four choices, fish and chips, beef shepherds pie, mushroom risotto, or sausage and chips. Your drink is on your own and you also preorder that and pay when you get to the pub. After lunch you get about 15 minutes to walk around this very cute village. Next stop is Bath. We arrived there about 4:45pm. You are let off near the Roman Baths. If you want to go in it is 17.50 pounds each. We chose not to go but for those that did you spend about 30 minutes there. Otherwise, you walk around Bath where there are many shops and restaurants. We then met our bus at 6:15 and arrived back at the Victoria station at 9:00pm. Steven M was our house and we found him to be very knowledgeable and friendly. Daniel was our driver and he did a great job. Not sure how they manage that bus on some of those tiny roads, but he did!! Long day, but very interesting. Enjoy!

We enjoyed the tour. Our guide was nice and very informative. It was cool seeing the Stonehenge and lacock village. What they dont tell you on the website is that it's a highlight. We found that out once we were on the bus going to the first location. You get an hour at each location (hour an a half at Stonehenge), but in reality you don't. You have to wait for everyone to get off the bus and then she talks to us telling us what time to be back and what we should check out. That wastes about 15 minutes. For Windsor castle you have to walk around fast and not really listen to the autoguide. Same thing for the Roman Bath if you choose to go in. I would have rated it higher if they gave us more time at each location and if the guide told us the information when we were arriving so that we don't waste those 15 minutes.

Our tour guide, Steve Maynard, was pure unadulterated awesome sauce. It's a tightly scheduled tour so fellow tourists' timeliness will definitely affect your enjoyment of the trip. Ours had a few who were a little slow coming back from Windsor, so late lunch was a late late lunch and Bath was shutting down as we arrived. Steve made the best of our situation and kept everyone in high spirits. He was funny and informative. Would not hesitate to book any tour led by Steve.

I was in London for a business trip and only had 2 days to explore, I took the chance and booked this tour, it was incredible! In one day I saw 4 beautiful places. The tour guide Karen and the driver Syd were incredible (Hope I got those names correct). You need to be there on time, and understand that you are doing a lot in one day, so it is limited time in each area. If you understand that you will have a great time and a experience you will never forget.

If your trip is based in London and you want a organized way to see these sights then this tour is perfect for you! You’ll see the key bits and learn the fascinating history of these sites and get enough of a taste to decide if you want to come back and make a proper visit. This tour is all day but is worth the effort. Plus you have the bonus of sneaking in a quick nap on the motor coach.

This trip by Premium Tours was exceptional. The coach was clean, air conditioned and comfortable, the tour guide (Steve M) was very accommodating & knowledgeable. Windsor Castle is impressive and Bath is a beautiful part of England. The little 14th Century town of Lacock is amazing, it’s well worth a visit. The whole experience was really enjoyable and memorable. Our driver Turguy took great care of us, the ride was so smooth I managed to have a quick nap.
