All in all, a very well organised and professional operation. Highly recommended!
We went on this tour on a satursday morning with a couple of friends. We enjoyed the Castle but felt a bit rushed. Nice but very crowded, anyway Stonehenge was beautiful. I would recommend this tour.

What an amazing tour. With being a 12 hour day trip, Karen brought knowledge of London, insight to each location, with great stories AND laughter! We couldn’t have asked for a better guide to make this day extraordinary! Felt super safe with Kevin behind the wheel despite the twists and turns. Surprised with his ability to maneuver that big bus with such ease!!
This tour was well worth the money!!
Alan & Giles

was very memorable place I have ever seen.
How the stons could be built like that , I was so impresed.
you should go there once

I booked this tour on the advice of a friend who went on it a month prior — such great advice! The day starts early and the Victoria Coach Station is confusing a frustrating. It would have been nice if the company had a sign or something at the gate to indicate that the tour was leaving from there. As it was, lots of passengers were just as confused and anxious as I was until an announcement was made just minutes before our boarding time.
But, once we boarded, everything was great! Our guide, Leon, was knowledgeable, entertaining and patient — all the traits needed for a long tour with a big group. There were about 80 people on our bus and Leon managed the crowd well, even in the crowds at Windsor & Bath.
Visiting Windsor Castle and seeing the changing of the guard was an unexpected delight. Bath was truly beautiful. Lacock was fascinating and charming. And Stonehenge, the true reason for us to be on the tour, was breathtaking.
I’ve been to England several times and to Stonehenge before, but this was my first trip with my children (ages 6, 9 & 13). The tour was perfectly manageable for all of them and the bus ride gave the youngest (& me!) time to sneak in a nap. It was wonderful seeing the countryside and towns I’d never seen before. I highly recommend this tour. It’s worth every penny!

If you don't have much time -- and want to see a lot -- this is your tour. You spend more time on the bus (luckily a nice double decker one) than in the locations. But it was great to see it all in one day trip out of London. A little chaotic in Victoria Coach Station, but once on board it all ran smoothly. Fun to see Windsor Castle and the changing of the guard. Bath is a great town. Lunch in Lackock was surprisingly good - and a nice break. And Stonehenge was Stonehenge. Not much time in any place. And our guide, Gavin - was superb. It must have been hard to be so funny and cheerful for more than 12 hours, but he did it. No complaints at all, but it is a long day.

My family and I really enjoyed this trip. You see a lot in a single day. BUT BE ADVISED... you will not be back in London until at least 8:30pm. Don’t let the term “pub lunch” fool you into thinking you’ll be back early. It’s more of a “pub dinner”. We did and unfortunately had to forfeit some theatre tickets for that night. Our fault for not reading fully but still, I wish TripAdvisor would clearly show trip durations on their front page. Sorry for my rant...
Magnus, our tour guide, was very informative and a bit quirky. Great tour overall.

Up front: if you hadn't already guessed when you signed up for a day tour of 4 different and disparate venues in England, this is a bit of a whirlwind tour. But, it is definitely a packed day, and you get a real taste of each of the places you visit.

Stonehenge was the real impetus for my husband and I going on this tour, and we didn't regret it. We were also surprisingly charmed by Lacock, and were delighted to spend some time in Bath -- although we didn't get the time to fully explore the area.

Malcolm (the "Steerologist," as he so dubbed himself) and Magnus, our tour guide, were both absolutely wonderful and brought so much knowledge and humor to the tour. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to get the most out of a day outside of Greater London!

The most enjoyable thing i had in this place was in Bath. well, other remained historic and countryside atmosphere is gorgeous as well. Don't wanna write too much but this is a highly recommended that go with your partner.

This tour is a great way to see the countryside and historic places. Stonehenge really interesting with new facilities and visitor centre. Bath, beautiful with all the stone buildings and if you are a Jane Austen fan and a great lunch in a British Pub.

The guide and bus driver were top notch. My only disappointment was that going to Bath did not include seeing the Roman baths due to time constraints. I had thought that was the purpose. Instead it was a drop off to do shopping, which I had no interest in. Still very worthwhile, highly recommend.

Guys, you are AMAZING! Steve was our guide and Sid our driver, and they were both super helping and super fun! I really cannot understand how these gentlemen are able to be so nice and brilliant even after such a long and demanding trip, and with all those people to manage.
Steve gave us plenty of interesting information in a really entertaining way, and listening to him was a pleasure. Sid was attentive and smiling, and his driving made us feel safe at all times.
Guys, you are stars.
Wasted good valuable time hanging around Stonehenge for far too long (seemed like 2 hours-just hanging around buying in the shop) didn't get to Bath until dark; Never again!

Dominic and Nadia made the trip. Thank you. He gave us times to get back at the bus so we can plan accordingly but we ended up leaving 4 people to not disrespect the rest of our trip..we waited as long as possible. Great sense of humor for all!

This kind of tour has no hassle and good when you just wanted to see this particulat famous tourist spots! Claudia was excellent as our tour guide...the food was delish and i could do this travel all over again :-)

Don’t be worried about the pace! This is a perfect tour sharing iconic treasures PLUS a stop in rural England for a great hearty lunch. I absolutely loved every minute and our guide Lizzy wonderful - her wit and knowledge impressive! This tour was my favourite day in England! Highly recommend.

I had Dominic as my tour guide and he was terrific and lively. I highly recommend wearing your best walking shoes as this tour has lots of walking on it. Especially in Bath. Lightweights like me will also enjoy, I especially enjoyed the state apartments at Windsor and the museum at Stonehenge.

We loved our trip! You must keep the tight schedule but its worth it. For us we wanted to pack in as much as possible so we picked the all day adventure. You are going and going all day but it was worth it to see so much! Our advice is to Tour the Roman Baths if you are not a shopper. That is one thing we wish we had done. Bath is very nice but really more of a shopping stop. Had we known that we would have done the tour of the Roman Baths instead of walking around town. You wont regret going on this trip, tour guide was great too! Enjoy! Wishing we were back in England we had a wonderful visit!

This was awesome!!
Jam packed day but definitely worth it!
Our guide was great and had a wealth of information.
Pub food was okay, but everything else was great.

A fast paced highlights tour which gives you enough information if you want to come back on future visits to look around more or if you only have a short time. Our guide Julie was always giving us information & checking we understood instructions & Malcolm the bus driver was very professional. Over the Christmas break though lines were quite long which meant you had to keep moving at each stop especially Stonehenge. We would recommend this tour if you want to see highlights in one day with plenty of interesting facts.

We had nothing to do on Boxing Day, so we signed up for this tour. We knew that we would not be spending much time anywhere, but that was OK. Windsor Castle was closed for the holiday, but Premium notified us of that, asked if we wanted to keep the booking, then credited us for that portion. We still visited the lovely town of Windsor, and that was nice. Next was Stonehenge, where we had an hour, which was certainly enough to know that we want to go back. Lunch in a rather so-so touristy pub, but the brews were great. Unfortunately, Bath was dark and rainy by 3 o'clock, but that is December. Finally, a wet nighttime tour of Lacock, which I would love to revisit.
It was hit and run, but we knew it would be. It whets the appetite for return visits, and provides for great photos. The best part was the history provided by Magnus Nielsen, a terrific guide. Ricardo, our driver, provided professionalism and good humor, and was the best coach driver that I have ever encountered.

This tour was the highlight of our trip to the U.K.! In my opinion, a tour is really as good as your tour guide, and our guides, Dan and Malcolm, were absolutely fantastic. Dan did an excellent job with interesting facts and history throughout the trip, as well as direction where needed. At each destination, he told us where we should focus and which areas to reserve for last/skip. This made visiting each site much more enjoyable and less overwhelming.

The views were fantastic!! Albeit cloudy throughout the day, the expansive landscape and charming villages were endearing. The dinner in Lacock was delicious. Food orders were taken on the bus ride so service was effective and quick when we arrived. There is a chocolate store in Lacock called "Coco Lab" and it is worth visiting if you have extra time after your meal. We also opted to pay for the Roman bath tour and it was well worth it! Even if you don't opt for the bath house, the town of Bath itself is vibrant with many stores and places to explore during your time there.

The views along the way are fantastic. We stayed in London City so a view of the countryside was well-invited. Malcolm did a phenomenal job of getting us there on time, and Dan did a great job of keeping us up to date. Again, for your money, this trip is the bee's knees!

Such great value! Our tour guide Jose kept us entertained with so many stories about these 4 amazing places, you felt like you'd made a new friend. And our driver Christian did an excellent job as well and made us feel safe. I'm glad we chose this tour with the pub meal in Lacock, which your menu choice was arranged on the bus and served immediately on our arrival. This allowed time to walk about and see some of the places in the Harry Potter movies. We opted to tour the Roman Baths, in Bath, which was an extra charge but Jose arranged it so we didn't have to wait in line and it was well worth it. My favourite part was Stonehenge and we arrived there at about 5 p.m. which made for an awesome sky in the background of our pictures. We got back to the hotel at about 9 p.m. so I'd recommend not scheduling yourself an early morning the next day, but the long day was worth it. The bus was comfortable and as I had said Christian made us feel safe on the drive through this beautiful countryside
Our guide was amazing. His depth and breadth of facts was astonishing. He was very clear about the details of the logistics of the trip as well.

Great way to explore England in a day!
Each location was unique and a fun visit.

One downside is you are a bit rushed at each stop.
Would recommend if you have limited time in England.
We had a great time our tour guide Richard was really fun to be with, and Alex our bus guy was really helpful, the overall experience was amazing.
This was a great tour EXCEPT we didn’t get to see the Roman ruins in Bath!! We really enjoyed our guide!

Peter and Andrei were amazing! The tour exceeded our expectations and MORE. Peter made a rainy trip to 4 locations enjoyable and Andrei was a pro driver. make sure you read the reviews! If you are one to want to take your time at each location, THIS IS NOT THE TOUR FOR YOU. we had about 1 hour 20 minutes to 1 hour and 45 minutes at each location. It was perfect for us as we were in town for an extended layover. Some passengers were complaining that the tour felt rushed, they obviously did not read the reviews. One thing that was a little disappointing was that a coupe was late 30 minutes and we had to wait for them. At the beginning of the tour, the guide told us if we're late they will leave because it is like stealing time from others. The couple was not really apologetic and we could have gotten home 30 minutes sooner...in the end we did get hour an hour later than the tour stated in the booking... other than that great tour!

This was a fantastic experience as part of our visit to England. Ana Maria and Ricardo got us to all of the locations on time so we would have maximum time at each stop and Ana Maria’s narrative during the ride as well as at each location prepared us for each location so that we were able to see all of the important spots.
I cannot recommend this tour enough!!!! It’s so great to get out of the hustle and bustle of London and see more of the countryside and other locations throughout the Commonwealth.
David (guide) and Ricardo (driver) were both amazing at their job. It was an enjoyable tour, one that I would take again if they were the ones operating the tour.

Frank and Chris team up for a humorous experience! We thoroughly enjoyed the bits of information and perspective while driving, not to mention the main attractions. This was our first trip through the UK.

Our guide Frank was amazing he made the trip so enjoyable with all his knowledge about every place also our bus driver Chris was also amazing Frank and Chris were both so funny!! and I love the fact that Frank and Chris both helped out with lunch!!!
Chris (the driver) and Frank ( the tour narrator) were wonderful and extremely knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour.

Frank and Chris were great! Knowledgeable and fun. Highly recommend the excursion to see the things in the country and experience a bit more of 🇬🇧!!
Thanks for a great time!
Clive was great but due to late people getting back to the bus Bath was closed when we got there. Clive was great and was beyond his control!

Zozo (tourist guide) and Carlos (coach driver) are so nice and funny. Zozo has a lot of interesting stories.
I highly recommend taking the tour!
Our guide, Leon, was an absolute delight. Great infusion of history, humor, and facts. Very long day, but done very well so you don’t feel like it’s rushing around. Thoroughly enjoyed!!!

The sites were interesting and worth exploring. It was a long day with alot of distance to cover. Unfortunately Tour Guide Toby from Premier Tours handled it very poorly. First off, Windsor Palace was closed due to the Queen's death. This was understandable but he still opted to spend 2 hours there with very little to see and do. This resulted in severe time restriction at Stonehenge &Bath - just an hour for each which was not nearly enough time. Couldn't hear his commentary outside the coach because he didn't project his voice. Another issue is that we never had lunch till 5pm!! The pub had very little time to dedicate to our group as they were now busy preparing for their dinner bookings.
When we were ready to leave Lacock and Toby did the headcount he realized that 2 persons were missing. Within 3 minutes he declared that we will have to leave them behind!! This l found to be totally UNACCEPTABLE considering he didn't even bother to find out if they were lost, ill etc ( bus had to park some distance away from the Pub so we had to find our way back to the bus). Furthermore Lackock is off the beaten path and chances of the couple being able to find their way back to London at that hour would be very slim. Thankfully Driver Andre went in search of them and we were all reunited in about 5 mins. This could have been a lovely day if we had a good Tour Guide. Its been 2 weeks since l wrote to Premium Tours and complained and have heard nothing; l therefore will not recommend Premium Tours and will not take another tour with them. Only thing premium about them is their prices!
Clive and Nuno were awesome! Great trip that packed in a lot. We enjoyed all 4 stops and the bus ride gives you proper rest.

Comfortable bus ride, knowledgeable tour guide, and an extra stop in a quaint little village not offered by other tours. We enjoyed the ease of only having to show up at a certain time and somebody else doing the rest.
Bath. Great town. Would like to spend more time there. The City has great history and a number of shops and cafes.

The tour guide on September 4th was great. Enthusiastic, knowledgeable,personable. He made the trip great.
Our driver Carlos was great too. Wonderful driver
The timing of everything and the sites were fabulous! Lunch was delicious and the tour guide was incredibly informative with historical facts at each place making the tour even more enjoyable.
Very cool. I’ve been told to say more, so I’ll also say you get much closer to Stonehenge than expected.
It is quite a long day and large group but Eugene was great. We enjoyed getting out of the city to see the sites and it was definitely a great way for us to do so.

Great tour guide. Eugene was fun and knowledgeable.
Wishing for longer stops and time spend in towns. It was too rushed.
Highly recommend to visit Lacock and Bath.
Excellent!!! Tour guide was amazing! Beautiful towns and scenic. The tour guide was very informative and made the trip!
great tour. Tour Guide(Clive) was very knowledgeable & had a great personality!! Saw the highlights of this tour proceeded by his briefing & knowledge. Highly recommend this tour!!
The guided tour was great for someone to cover the attractions if your short on time, great guide. TY

I had a fantastic time in all three places I went to. Unfortunately, the time in each place was not long enough. Nevertheless, it was a fantastic sample of each place enough to make me want to return❣️
Very knowledgeable guide, friendly driver, and excellent tour. Great way to see a lot in a short amount of time. Definitely recommend!

We had a fabulous day! Zozo was a perfect guide and took care of our group of 8. We were on a larger bus, but he took the time to answer all questions and make sure we had time to see the sights, get our questions answered, and have a perfect bucket list checking day! This trip
Was amazing!
This was the highlight of my visit to England. Mr Leon and Mr Carlos are the best hosts and guide. It was breathtaking and I learnt a lot. 10 out of ten.

We had a wonderful day today and our tour guide Zozo was amazing! He was extremely knowledgeable and told great stories! Would absolutely go on another tour with him. And the bus driver Andreas also did great job maneuvering the big bus!!

This tour was fantastic! The guide Leon was spectacular! And so was the driver Chris. He kept us entertained while learning the story of his country in such a fun way that I couldn't stop listening. He was very knowledgeable. This was the best part of our trip!

Windsor castle is closed on Tues. and Wed. This was not told during the planning process. We were told when we got on the bus. Going to Windsor castle was one of the reasons I chose this tour. I could have picked any day. Everything else was very nice.
This is a full day tour. So much history and beautiful countryside to see! Be sure to eat before the tour as it’s quite a while before you eat “lunch” at 5pm.

This was a 12 hour bus ride with 75 people. First, Windsor Castle was closed due to a ceremony. Not the tour's fault but a bummer. Had about 20 minutes in town to look around...not enough to do much. Lunch was a cluster as another smaller tour joined ours but lunch was not included with their tour. The guide apologized repeatedly...bottom line...the tour company should have eaten this and paid for the additional 10 or so lunches. Again no time to really explore the town. Off to Bath were we arrived so late, it was unclear if the baths would be open for a tour (not included). We barely got in but were rushed to make it back to the pus pickup. Bottom line...too much packed into one very long day, with not enough time at each stop. We don't recommend this one!
Andrew with Premium Tours was our tour guide and he was wonderful. The trip was long but informative and fun. We had a great time and would recommend.
The whole tour was well organized, we were given plenty of information and instructions ahead of time so it goes smoothly.

this tour was the best thing i got to do during my vacation in london
i got to go to places i only saw on tv , i got the chance to experience the real england
and not just the ordinary metropolitan of london
every desetination was more spectacular than the one before
and with the help of leon the tour giude this was just a pure adventure
Eugene and Ed were great! Eugene's commentary was a good blend of talking and quiet. His timing on when to look at something was perfect. Loved the count down!
We had a whirlwind of a day seeing so many attractions. Carol was a wealth of information and very charming. Andre is a marvelous driver. You can't go wrong with this tour.
The guide was good group was to large needed access to app or ear phones where all the people can hear and you are not having to stand as close

This was an amazing experience! Got to learn a little bit of history while seeing the sights and learning about how the same landmarks have sustained their history in modern day life! Super fascinating and had a great guide and driver! Would definitely recommend!
It was so fast. We flew from one place to the next. Right amount of time at Stonehenge but not enough at Windsor. Wish I had cut Bath for more Windsor.

We had such a good time on our tour! Mostly thanks to our driver Carlos and our tour guide Eugene! Eugene was funny and entertaining and definitely has this tour guide thing figured out!
Kept us on time and gave us a lot of history and information!!! We would choose this tour again! It is a very full busy day but what a great way to see a lot in a short time!
Loved the lunch we had in the old tavern in Lacock. Great experience!
Kudos to Eugene and Carlos for keeping us on time and working so well together as a team.
Carlos and Eugene were phenomenal tour guides. Gave a lot of interesting information and facts. Learned a lot. Highly recommend.

This is one of those tours that anyone who is in London must take.
It's a long tour, but every minute of the tour is amazing.
You get to know beautiful places and get to know more about England
Our guide Lucy was amazing. The bus was clean and Carlos out drive was great. I would highly recommend this tour. Lunch was delicious.
Andrew and Carlos (and Kevin) were wonderful! The trip was a great experience but Andrew made it worthwhile. He was very personable and knowledgeable.
The host was fabulous, smart, witty, charming and knowledgeable about the area. He did a great job of keeping the day interesting and the very busy day flowing smoothly.
This tour is, as my title suggests, a mere introduction to these treasures and leaves the tourist wanting more.
I would highly recommend this tour. Karen was a fantastic,friendly, informative tour guide and we felt very safe with Lamar’s driving.
Windsor Castle was our favorite. The guides made everything fun and interesting. Lacock pub lunch was great.
Eugene was a wonderful tour guide and our driver was excellent! I enjoyed the commentary at each location. I would absolutely go again with these gentlemen!
It was awesome and Derrick the tour guide and Germaine the bus driver were awesome. They were both very helpful and informative of the tours.
We went on a great day trip with Derrick, and tour driver, Germaine. The Stonehenge and Windsor sites were spectacular. The only downside was that there was not enough time at these sites.
Carol our tour guide was absolutely amazing! Her knowledge on all the sites we visited was more than we could have imagined. She made our experience so enjoyable!
Great experience! Our guide (Andrew) was insanely knowledgeable, and our driver (Carlos) got us to and from both quickly and safely. You will 100% enjoy this full-day trip.
Wonderful trip and well worth the time. Frank (our Guide) and Carlos (our Driver) were awesome. Would highly recommend this trip to anyone. The lunch in Lacock was awesome as well.

Omgosh, this tour was amazing! It was long but worth every minute! The sights we visited and the landscapes were just beautiful and breathtaking! Alan, our tour guide, was extremely funny, personable, and informative! Our driver, name i can’t remember, can drive that Coach! All-in-all, I love this tour and will do this again when I’m back in London, England!
Thank you Gavin and Richard for the amazing tour! best tour guide and driver I've ever met! Its a knowledgeable and fun trip :)

My bf and I booked this trip via Viator. We woke up early to make sure we knew how to get to Victoria Stage Coach. The ticket indicated we should arrive 15 min before boarding. They don’t lie! I’m glad we got there early.

Prepare for a long day of walking and driving. Our tour guide was Eugene and our driver was Haig. Eugene was funny, witty, and super knowledgeable. Haig was a great driver- felt very safe with his driving.

First stop was Windsor Castle which was about 30 min from London- it was awesome to be there because the Queen was actually there. We didn’t see her, but it was cool knowing she was around. We were able to see the Changing of the Guards as well which was an awesome experience. We learned a lot about the castle before we arrived and got to explore on our own.

Second stop was Stonehenge which was about 1.5 hrs from the castle. It was much colder heading out of London. The stones were pretty mind blowing knowing there are 80 plus HUGE and heavy stones- no one knows how they got there to this day- lots of history and history.

Third Stop was lunch at a pub in Lacock Village- it was cool to see the English homes.

And last stop was Bath. We visited the Roman Baths and enjoyed walking the city.

The tour was about 13 hours long.
The bus itself was clean and comfy. I would def recommend!

Tour guide David made this day worry free and very informative. The tour was well organized down to the smallest detail, such as David calling the pub with our drink orders so they were ready when we arrived! We chose this tour to see Windsor Castle and Stonehenge - both really enjoyable - but the lunch in the charming little town of a Lacock was an unexpected highlight of the day.

Gavin and Carlos were the best! Gavin has so much energy and you can tell he really wants everyone to get the best experience possible. Carlos was the most considerate driver. Slowing down so we could get our pictures, taking more scenic routes,etc. Gavin is so knowledgeable and so helpful. 10/10 would recommend. Thank you so much for making our trip so special. ( wooo)

Gavin (with a G) and Carlos are THE BEST! Made our trip so special and memorable keeping us involved, entertained, excited and laughing the entire time! If you can, request them and you will be so lucky!!! Thank you so much you made our trip to London way worth while. My friends and I learned so much, saw so much, got amazing pictures, had good food, great laughs, and was pleasured with a memory of a lifetime! Thank you from USA !! Cheers :)

Pepe and Carlos were a great team! We enjoyed the trip.
Made our trip to London memorable and enjoyable.
The tour guide, Leon, was excellent. He was very knowledgeable, fun and upbeat. Our driver, Turgay, was also excellent. Although it was a long day, it was well worth it!

I took this tour with my husband and 2 children (7 and 10 years old). It was an early morning for us having to be at the bus station by 745 but we were instantly welcomed onto the bus by our tour guide, Karen. She paid special attention to the children and her overall upbeat voice and positive attitude made this trip what it was....a success! She could sell me a rotten banana with her positive attitude and enthusiastic tone.....we loved her!
The trip to Windsor was super short but we did get through every room on the tour (walking through quickly), stopped in the gift shop, and then walked through St. George’s chapel before getting back on the bus. They are dead serious about the time....there was a group that was left behind. Don’t feel sorry for them because it was made explicitly clear that we needed to be back by a certain time and they meant it! Seems a little mean but we didn’t get back that night until 830pm so I can’t imagine how late we would have been if everyone was late.
Stonehenge was....amazing....but make sure to dress warm! I made sure to bring lots of snacks for my kids because we didn’t end up having lunch until about 3-330-ish. It was late but worth it.
Lacock was a quaint little town and Bath was simply marvelous! Karen mentioned the oldest house in Bath which is now Sally Lind Bunns restaurant. While we were there it started to pour and the winds were fierce (like a hurricane).....I asked Karen where Sally Lind Bunns was and she offered to walk us there! In the pouring rain!!! Who does that?!?! She does! I thanked her but couldn’t accept her offer. We ended up finding it and going down to the basement museum ( free and worth it!) and had a famous Sally Lind Bunn (the one with strawberry jam is delicious)!

At the end of the day my husband and I agree this woman And our great driver (Lamar) earned their gratuity! I was happy to give her something because she had made our day so great. Somehow she managed to capture my 7 and 10 year olds attention throughout the trip. They were exhausted at the end of the day and so were we. If you don’t do well with lots of walking and a long day, This trip is not for you. But if you’re generally fine with this kind of thing then it’s definitely worth the money and time. We saw so much in 1 day!

This was sold by Viator and operated by Premium Tours. PLEASE DO NOT GO. The advertisement is fraudulent. The "lunch" is dinner and is garbage. The tour is rushed and we had minutes at all of the locations before we were shoved back on the bus. They gave us no time to feed our kids and the tour guide was rude. Do yourself a favor and STAY AWAY.

The itinerary says 90 minutes at Windsor Castle and 30 minutes at St George Chapel as well as 90 minutes at Stonehenge. This just does not happen. We had 30 minutes to actually spend seeing Windsor Castle the remainder of the time was spent waiting outside. This was only enough time to see Queen Mary Doll House and State Apartments. No time was spent at St George Chapel. Stonehenge was only enough time to take second bus to stones take a photo and head back to tour bus. I would recommend to choose a different tour that doesnt try to fit in so much in one day as these sights arent close together and most time is spent on the bus. As the tour guide stated it is really a teaser tour.

Tour guide was great however, very knowledgeable.

This tour is ambitious in trying to see four sites in one day. If you prefer a slow-paced tour, this might not be a good match. Winter doesn't help since it got dark by 4:30. We had some scheduling challenges due to larger crowds than typical at some of the attractions and some of the trip passengers not making it back to the bus on time at a few stops. All that said, the experience was still enjoyable. I learned a lot and got to check some serious boxes in seeing Windsor Palace and Stonehenge.

Amazing from start to finish. Friendly tour guide who was also very knowledgeable about all places visited.

Love from Belize 🥰

This was a wonderful, compact tour with just enough time in each site to cover the important parts. I only had one day free on a business trip to London, and I felt like I got a healthy dose of history considering the limited time. Gavin did an excellent job of giving an animated retelling of the historical events that took place in each site, and added in a dose of fun pop culture trivia for those less historically inclined. His cheerful energy did a great job of combatting the inevitable dreariness of the drizzly English weather! And I was impressed that we were able to get it all done in time to make it to the next site each stop. Also included a solid lunch for a tour lunch stop (I used to work for a tour company and I know how hard it is to book a pub lunch for 30 in the Cotswolds!), and a healthy dose of royal history, literary history, and film history to keep everyone engaged. People couldn't stop talking about what a great tour guide we had, and our bus driver was pretty fun, too!

P.S. Definitely include the Windsor entrance because that's the best part.

Truly a wonderful all day(12 hour) excursion with guide, Peter and driver, Abdul. Lots of sights to see throughout the day, but a great way to get out of London and see the countryside. Visits to each location are short, but include enough time to get a taste of each sight. The trips are well timed and Peter and Abdul did a great job of keeping our group on schedule. Peter knows a lot of history and shares his knowledge throughout the trip. His sense of humor and enthusiasm made the trip enjoyable. Highly recommend. At some point will need to purchase food, so if have a favorite sandwich shop, good idea to purchase and bring onboard.

With this tour, you get to see A LOT in a short amount of time. All four stops were fantastic, and I personally felt that we had plenty of time to take it all in. The only place where I would have liked to spend more time was Bath. You could do the Roman Baths OR tour the town, but we really didn't have time for both fully. Luckily, it was pretty quiet, so we were able to make it through the baths pretty quickly and still have about 25 minutes to poke in some shops.
Gavin was one of the best tour guides we have had! He was knowledgeable, helpful, friendly, entertaining . . . can't say enough positive things. You can tell that he genuinely wants his guests to have a fantastic time which we did indeed. Thank you for the great day!
Very knowledgeable guide and professional staff. Made for a very enjoyable day. All sights were just what I had imagined. Thank you
Thank you Gavin and Andrew for the amazing tour and all of your stories and explanations. We say hipip huraaaaaa and well done

Gavin was fun, entertaining and knowledgeable. He loves the culture and will tell you EVERYTHING happening behind the walls. He personalizes the tour by adding on mini experiences for free. He was lovely, and I RECOMMEND!

Booked this trip for a Sunday in London. Tour left on time 7:45 am from Victoria Coach Station. Gavin really made the trip. From the moment we got on the bus, he was friendly, knowledgeable and charming, a complete delight to hear his stories and his singing is phenomenal. He engaged my 10 year old boy during the whole trip and it really made him feel as part of the tour. Lunch at the George Inn was really good, all our destinations were done on time and Gavin managed and engaged the whole group at all times. He even knew how long the crossing light will last (8 seconds)!!! Overall great trip and great tour, if you can have Gavin, you are up for a treat. Thank you Gavin with a G for an amazing tour and all your stories and knowledge. Innessa, Leo and Louie from NY.

I booked this from US easily from Tripadvisor, the meeting point was Victoria Coach Line station in London, they usually use the last gates for this tours and others, gate 18 or 19, there are the Premium Tours representatives there, It was in time and the bus was very comfortable with two decks, I get stuck in Windsor Castle and lost the tours there. I tried to call the company phone and cannot talk to anybody from Windsor, hopefully there was another Premium Tour Coach parked and I was able to talk to the driver later, this person was very kind with us and called to the company and to the driver and guide from my original tours and they can arrange to us next day tours to Stonehenge and Bath. I let my backpack in the leaving tour and they talked me there is no problem for the next day. Returned to London by train to do another walking day and the next day, the company representatives were very kind with us and we can took the rest of the tour and the backpack was OK. It was a good experience and tell the company Thanks for all issues happen to us. Please you guys need to fix the Phone or other communication alternatives because the phone publish is not working so far when happen a emergency like it happened to us!... For another thing, you guys done very good.
Perhaps one of the best tour experiences I have had in London. Gavin was EXTREMELY helpful and knowledgeable (and amusing)! How often does one get a tour guide who can sing, after all?
Highly recommended, awesome hosts (Gavin & Carlos ) full of knowledge & insight into all places visited. Steady pace not full on like some tours.

Fun experience for the whole family. It was a long day but we had a blast at each stop. Minor drawback was that we got to Bath a little too late in the day to really experience it and we were pretty low on steam since it was our 4th stop of the day, but Windsor, Stonehenge and Lacock more than made up for it. Our guide, Karen, was excellent and extremely entertaining.

We had a great time the trip was a full day but surely didn’t feel that way! Wish we had more time at each place but understandably know why we couldn’t as it was packed full of adventure! Our 7 year old enjoyed as well!

It was a good tour, the only downside is we were too late to see the Roman Baths and that was part of the reason we booked the trip. If I had realized that there was a possibility you could miss it, I would have maybe booked a different tour without the lunch detour. It was a good tour to see some of the scenery driving through England.
Can’t imagine it’s possible to do all of this in one day by yourself! Tour guide was fantastic, travel coach was comfortable, sites were amazing!
Eugene was a witty, entertaining tour guide Teamed with the smooth coach driving of Carlos... a dynamic duo.. very entertaining and fun filled day.. favourites were Stonehenge and Bath ..

Eugene and our driver Carlos were awesome the whole day. The tour takes the full day as it is 12+ hours but it is a great time and time flies when your having fun! Just enough time in each place to get you to want more. I would recommend this tour to anyone!

If you’re looking for a well organized tour, look no further. We spent a great day, albeit very long, with Eugene and Malcom. The two made our journey to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge effortless and painless. We had enough time at each location to explore the area. Eugene was very knowledgeable and provided many stories and information tidbits to provide historical context to the tour. Plan to bring water and snacks as the tour lasts roughly 12.5 hrs.

Took this coach our not knowing what to expect and we were more then pleasantly surprised. Eugene and Malcom worked extremely well together and were both very informative and entertaining. We would highly recommend this tour.
We just wish we had a bit more time in both Bath and Lacock. I’d give this 9 starts. Thank you both
Eugene and Carols provided a fantastic tour of Windsor, Stonehenge and Baff. Tour filled with bits of history, culture points and lots of wit! Highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting

It was nice to see so much.... but the timing for Windsor bath lunch and stone henge was rushed. Our guide Eugene was very nice and did a great job of getting us there and back from all the stops! Very efficient

Be prepared for a very long day, with potentially no restroom on the coach, and a guide that is knowledgeable but has long passed his honeymoon days of coach ambassador. Andrew, our guide, used cynical, punitive humor to keep us in line as if we were fourth graders on our first field trip. He undoubtedly has experienced his share of guest’s bad behaviors, and uses dark humor to ward off any potential calamities, such as not sitting in one’s initially chosen seat, and being left behind if not back to the coach in time. The coach was also fairly uncomfortable- even for average-sized persons.
I would not recommend this guide, but the sites are worth seeing if you’re lucky enough to score a more enlightening guide and A coach with a working loo. Oh, forget WiFi for this excursion, You’re bound to use up your day’s worth of data, especially on the long ride back to London.

Great tour. Our guide was fun and knowledgeable. The audio tour of Windsor castle was great, Bath was beautiful and stonehenge was epic. Our lunch was nothing special but they were very fast getting us in and out fast. The town of Lacock was also very cool, and the filming location for many scenes in the Harry Potter series which was cool. I highly recommend this tour but keep in mind it is an all day event, about 12 hours I think. Left in the early morning and didn't return until around 8pm.

Many have commented that a lot is packed into this tour and there is. Don’t expect to be dawdling around for hours at each place. I enjoyed the pace and our guide, Leon made it clear that we were hitting the highlights and I was ok with that. For me, traveling with my 80yo mother, this was a easy and great way to get to all these places. Leon was fab as a tour guide, gave so much insight all day. Even at the last moments before we were dropped off, he was still sharing info, which was awesome after such a long day!

Tourguy as the driver killed it! I’m in awe of how he wheels around that huge bus in cramped areas. He grabbed us a taxi on the street as we were leaving, this was a little thing that was much appreciated!

One thing we weren’t aware of is how many steps there would be and the walk to Windsor Castle was almost too much for my mom. She has trouble with stairs and hills, had a knee replacement a while ago so stairs are not her friend. She did the 50-some steps and on the way back we realized there was a lift! We talked to Leon about this and he said it often doesn’t work so he doesn’t always mentioned it but it was working that day and I wish we knew about it. So we took it on the way down. Although she enjoyed the castle, she would have enjoyed it more if she took the lift.

But, I will also take some blame, I didn’t realize how much walking there was, nor did I talk to the company beforehand about it. We made it though, and Leon’s encouragement along the way helped!

Our group was big but Leon was great at ensuring he repeated things so everyone knew what was going on. Oh, I almost got lost on the way back to the bus after the castle, because I was more focused on my mom than paying attention. Just a warning that you have to make your way back.

Stonehenge was amazing! The time there was plentiful.

We opted to walk around Bath and went into the Abbey which was beautiful! Glad we went in there. Plus it was free. :)

My mom’s quote: “Leon was very informative, I learned a lot of new things about the royal family. I quite enjoyed the tour, it was worth the money. Even in the pouring rain it was enjoyable!” My mom rocks. :)

Great team
Great trip
The trip is running from end to another, is not a heads deep trip, its an overhead one, but with the duo we gotten, it's just amazing

Lucy and Malcolm were absolute gems- I will highly recommend this tour. Windsor was absolutely breathtaking, Bath was beautiful and the Lacock stop was a good meal with new friends. Stonehenge is a head scratcher that’s for sure !

We took this tour because we didn’t want to drive, but we wanted to see more than London while we were here. We were not disappointed.
The coach ran into traffic issues, so there was limited time at Windsor Castle, but we chose to check out the State Apartments, and there is strictly no photography allowed there, so it didn’t take long to see it anyway, and we had about 10 minutes to spare to shop in the gift shop. With more time, we would have checked out a bit more of Windsor town.
We got just over an hour to look around Bath, which if you don’t want to go to the museum (we didn’t) was enough time to get some great pics and shop.
Lunch at Lacock was really well-organized and quick - average in terms of quality/flavour. The village is awesome - like stepping back in time.
We got just over an hour at Stonehenge, which was enough time to stay up there for a bit, shop the souvenir shop, and have a drink at the cafe.
The tour guide really knew her history - provided great information about each of the stops. I would recommend this tour (a 12-13 hr day) to take in some great highlights.

We did tour 79 but in a different order then listed. Leon was a great tour guide providing wonderful historic information and answering everyone's questions. Also, our coach driver got us through some tight places so we had time to see everything. This is a fast paced, whirlwind tour but you cover alot in a day.
Our tour guide, Gavin, was amazing! He made the long day so much more enjoyable. I would recommend asking for him.

My family and I took this tour and had an absolutely fabulous time! We never felt rushed at any of the spots and our guide Gavin (with a G) was absolutely fabulous! He was entertaining, funny, knowledgeable and genuinely wanted everyone to have a great time. He made the 2 hour bus ride to Bath quick and easy with his stories and information. The lunch in the pub in Lacock was delicious and quick. We saw the best of each location and ended the day with a magnificent Look at Stonehenge! Fun filled day that made lasting memories for our family! It’s a must do if you have a full day to dedicate to the tour.

My wife and I had a blast on this trip. It’s definitely more of a highlight tour but that’s the only way to see all of these places in one day and maximize your time. Our tour guide and driver were top notch.

We visited this place in the month of Aug, Bus takes Approx 20 pound to reach there but there are also another option by walk . Walking takes 25 -30 mins to reach from the entry point but the nature and beauty we enjoyed via walking from the fields are awesome. In winter season don't recommend to walk till stone henge.
Highly recommended. Great guide. Loved it. We were blessed with beautiful weather. Bus was comfortable. Decent enough time in Stonehenge. I actually went in June 2018.
We had a wonderful trip! I loved Bath!!! My only complaint is the lunch in Lacock. There has to be another place they can stop for lunch! I would recommend doing this trip but skipping the pub lunch!
What a wonderful trip!! We enjoyed the entire day... lunch was great and the trip went smoothly! Enjoyed everything about it!!

The trip was a great way to fit in four events in one package. The time allotment for each was appropriate, given the amount of miles that needed to be covered. The guide gave some wonderful historical background to each area we visited. Overall a great introduction to some of England’s great treasures!

This day trip was fantastic. It’s a long day but we were not rushed at any of the venues. Our guide Leon was amazing and I would have thought he was a history major with all the background and factoids that he told us. Not just about the venues but much more. He kept us completely entertained. Our driver Valdet is also worth praise. The English countryside is spectacular and picturesque. The highlight for me was Stonehenge. I would definitely recommend this tour.

I loved everything about the tour! The guide, Peter, was so knowledge and funny. He really made learning the history of each location so interesting and enjoyable. The lunch is a must. Dining in a 14th century pub in Lacock is a treat! If you have a day to to this tour , it is a must!!!!

Comfortable coach and great tour. Driver Christian and guide Leon were professional and knowledgeable. We had so much fun. Wish we had more time for additional tours. I will recommend to anyone I know is coming to London.

We had a great time on this tour. We were guided by the dapper, dynamic duo of Andre the magnificent driver and Eugene the amazing guide. Eugene had so much historic and modern day knowledge of all our sites with an enjoyable witty twist.
He prepared us well prior to walking into any sites and made sure we were one of the first groups to Windsor Castle.
There were certain sites i would have loved to stay longer but everything was planned accordingly to stay on time to see so much in one day.
The bus was comfortable and Andre drove like a dream. Eugene always checked if the temperature was comfortable.
I would absolutely recommend this tour, we had a lovely time.

We only had a few days in London so this trip was perfect! Peter our tour guide was amazing!! He told us from the get-go that we were doing a tour that usually can be done a day each. However, if you want to see it and have limited time, this is for you! Windsor, Bath, Lunch in Lacock, and Stonehenge was a great tour and we honestly got to see everything we wanted to. Peter was very entertaining throughout the tour and our driver, Valdale was great!

Eugene (the guide) was so knowledgeable and was an educational experience for us. He made the long day seem short.We enjoyed the trip tremendously! Yousif (the driver) need a lot of applause for driving those narrow roads in the villages! What an exceptional driver!
For those who are planning to go to Stonehenge, please book with this company. The bus was exceptionally clean and comfortable.
Great trip with really informative and entertaining commentary by Eugene and delightful driving by Fernando.

This was a great tour! We only had 2 days in London, and I chose this tour for our group of 6. Our tour guide, Lucy, was splendid. She had a good sense of humor, knows her history, and was very informative and helpful. My favorite site was Stonehenge. The area is still remote and undeveloped surrounding the site, so it was a beautiful setting, and the stone circles are impressive and gave me a lot to think about regarding what we think of modern intelligence. Windsor Castle was lovely and if you get there early- as Lucy had us, it was enjoyable- later in the day the number of people is too much for my comfort. Bath was beautiful, but I was disappointed that the Roman Baths are NOT part of the tour- it's a separate museum ticket to be purchased in Bath, and I didn't feel that we had enough time for me to stand in line for the ticket and to see the baths. The town is something to behold because the buildings are all made of limestone, so that was worth seeing. Lacock was slow paced- which we needed after a busy start to the day, and the lunch was good. I would recommend this tour.

Nicely done tour. The time at the stops seemed short but there was a lot of ground covered. Just the nature of these kinds of tours if you only have one day. The tour guide was really good and helpful.

Just what we wanted. We had little time to See Great Brittain and knew that we needed to get to the Stones and the Castle. We were pleasantly engaged by Bath and LaCock. Just like the action packed Big Screen Adventure series - one hit after another. We give it 5 stars because we knew what we wanted and the price was right.

The trip was scheduled for 12 hours, but ended up being closer to 15. The sites were fantastic but we just weren't allowed enough time. We had roughly 30 minutes to look around Windsor Castle by the time we got inside. Stonehenge was great, didnt need much time there. Bath is a place that needs extra time to explore. We got 45 minutes. The dinner at the pub in Lacock was average, but the town was very quaint and charming. Biggest complaint was the A/C on the bus wasn't working for most of the trip which made the transport unbearable. The tour guide Andrew was knowledgeable and funny.

Our guide and driver; what a TEAM. While Abdul deftly maneuvered our double decker bus through the narrow paths of London on to the roads of England for the next hours Eugene kept us informed.

Eugene was there whenever it was time to reboard the bus after a stop making it easy to find him and keeping the long day moving. He kept quiet when appropriate and made a "wakee wakeee" call when it was time to brief the next destination. Both were friendly and approachable.

For lunch he helped the pub staff serve us to expedite the service and give us more time to wander the little village of Lacock. In all a worthwhile, albeit long day trip. We saw a lot and learned a lot of history as well. Interesting and worth it.

Tour was good overall. The bus was not perfect did not have WiFi as advertised, and guide tried her best but I was expecting a guided tour not here’s the sites and off you go on your own. As reported it was a long day and the time at the sites were short. Overall not a bad tour.

Excellent tour that delivered what it promised. Only hiccup was the long line to get into Windsor castle. I think we had to wait more than an hour in line to get in due to the sheer number of people visiting. The lunch at the pub was nice. We did not get tickets to see the Baths since there was a very long line. The Stonehenge part was my favorite.

Pepe our tour guide and Richard our driver were awesome. The trip is all day but worth it to see so many sights and outside of London. It is EXTREMELY fas paced and leaves you limited time to explore the destinations, but that was how the trip was advised to us - a sample of the things we were seeing so we could explore another time on our own. I went with my parents and though it was a little rushed, we managed to enjoy our time and not miss the bus (strict timeline so the bus WILL leave you behind. We also were with a small group so that was really nice, as we had a lot of room on the bus.
This was a really good trip. The tour bus was clean, the guide had lots of good information and, of course, the sights were amazing. I would recommend this trip to everyone.

Guide Gavin and our driver were very helpful and considerate of everyone in the tour group. Gavin was knowledgeable and entertaining, he had personal stories that added a lot of interest. Our driver kept us on schedule and assisted in rounding up stray tour members when they got lost.
More complete pick up instructions would be appreciated by those of us who do not know the systems in London.

Thanks so much to Anna Marie (guide) and Andre (driver) for a fantastic day in the English countryside. Andre knew the London traffic patterns to perfection and got us to each destination without any trouble. Anna Marie was so knowledgeable about each site and its significance, with detailed insights into the history of Britain. But she totally exceeded our expectations in that she had so much to share about areas that we were passing on our way. I learned about the use of brick in London vs. stone in Bath and in the cotswolds. I learned about Henry VIII and Anne Boelyn. I learned about the lady in the Royal Crescent who painted her door yellow and about Bath Abbey as the site of an ancient coronation. She specifically pointed out two houses in Lacock that made appearances in the first and sixth Harry Potter movies, respectively and made sure we knew how to walk there after lunch. Couldn't have been happier! Then at the end of the tour she chatted with us and gave us high quality concierge-level advice for the remaining days of our trip. I should add that it takes a fair amount of time to travel from one location to another so we had only about an hour at each site. This was perfect for our teens and tweens, and gave us plenty of time to rest. That being said, if you like to really tuck in at a historical site and read all the placards, you may feel a bit rushed. For first timers though, it's a magnificent introduction to some of the most important and beautiful places on earth. I can't wait to come back someday, and this trip taught me how to plan for those future visits

Well done to Anne Marie (tour manager) and Maurice (bus driver) who provided us with a wonderful taster of the beautiful English countryside and some stunning locations that we will definitely return to. Everything was organised so well, the day was informative, the trip was comfortable and the lunch in Lacock was very tasty. Highly recommended!!!
This was a great tour. Tour guide and bus driver were very nice and helpful. Overall a great tour to do

Tour is well worth the investment and allows plenty of time to see the sites. Eugene was very informative and filled the down time with interesting facts. Carlos was the driver and did an excellent job. I would highly recommend this day trip as part of any trip to London.

This was a fun trip made all the better by our guide Eugene and driver Carlos. Between the smooth driving and expert insights these two made an fantastic day even more so. Enjoy the trip.
Cheers!

I took this tour along with my Mom and cousin. It was a very long day but definitely worth it. I learned so much from our tour guide, Leon. He was full of facts and told stories in a fun and carefree manner. I enjoyed the banter between him and Ricardo, our bus driver. As I said it was a long day but Ricardo kept us safe and on the move in order to fit in all of the sights we were too see. I truly enjoyed this tour and learned a bunch.

My friend and I decided to take this day trip to see different parts of London as we were staying in Camden. Our guide was Eugene and our driver was Chris. They made a phenomenal team! Eugene provided exciting information on the history of London as well as utilizing humour to keep the tour interesting. We were a little disappointed with the time allocated to each activity. We did not purchase the tickets to tour the Castle and we spent 3 hours at this location. We then only spent about 20 minutes at Stonehenge which was what we were looking forward to the most. Although we had these time constraints we still really enjoyed the entire experience and we thought that the price was well worth the activity as we got to see several places in one day.

Omg! Taking a trip to see Stonehenge has been a bucket list item and these guys - our Driver: Martin and especially our Guide: Frank added so much to the day with stories, jokes, and they shared such a rapport together.

An incredible day made even better with those two. Highly recommend!! Thank you!

This was such an amazing tour, everything about it was well timed and extremely enjoyable. Eugene had amazing recommendations (follow his advice and get a deluxe hot choc at stonehenge, y u m) and his commentary throughout the tour was legendary and entertainingly informative. Dexter was also lovely and a wonderful driver, overall it was a great tour that was made even better by these two! :)

Long day and not much time at each stop. To be fair there was significant traffic and on the summer solstice Stonehenge didn’t open until 3pm. So this tour was out of the norm because the itinerary order was changed to accommodate the late opening of Stonehenge. However, we spent 9 hours on the bus to spend 4 hours at the sites. Our guide Lucy was fun, knowledgeable, and great.

We visited Hampton Castle, Stonehenge, Lacock and Bath on this trip. Gavin was our tour guide and James was the driver. We couldn't have asked for a better guide. Gavin was very knowledgeable and funny and extremely helpful as I was having trouble walking. I would definitely recommend this tour. We learned a lot and had a wonderful time doing so.

We had a wonderful time on this tour with Gavin with a G! Nuno was a great driver! Gavin was friendly and helpful throughout the tour. He was also informative and entertaining on the bus ride. He is a 5th generation Londoner and was very knowledgeable about history of the country, sites, and infrastructure. You get about 40 minutes to an hour at each site to explore on your own. Make sure to pack some snacks since the lunch is more of a dinner. We would recommend this tour for anyone who wants a taste of many historical sites packed into a single day.

We went to Hampton court instead of Windsor, personally I would have preferred Windsor (told in advance) but Hampton was beautifull as well with alot of interesting history.

What really made the tour above and beyond was Gavin, he was personable, respectfull, knowledgeable, and knew how to think on his feat to make sure any problems that arose did not affect the tour. He was extremely professional and made the day one to remember. Make sure go get Gavin if you want to have an outstanding trip!
Lucy and driver were awesome! Would do tour again! Windsor was super rushed but if Lucy didnt get us there quickly wld have never made it in to see anything....overall great tour!
Awesome experience. Awesome guide Andrew and driver. Food in Lacock was delicious (sausage and chips). Worth every penny. A must do when visiting UK for the first time.
This trip was amazing. Eugene, our tour guide was helpful, funny and very informative. Carlos, our driver, was great. This was the highlight of our trip to England

Wonderful tour guide.. Paul was great at telling interesting stories and keeping the group on time. We were dropped off and picked up close to gates. Paul gave tips and expectations about places that we visited.

Max was our guide- brilliant, hilarious. Beautiful weather, enjoyed the pub. Definitely worth it. Make sure you understand where the bus terminal is vs. the train station. That was confusing- some people missed the bus going to the wrong station.

Would love to give a huge “thank you” to Premium Tours for my amazing day, on Tuesday 28th May.

Tony B was our extremely safe and fantastic driver, and I THINK Steve was our amazing and very knowledgeable tour guide - I’m incredibly sorry if I have his name wrong!

It was definitely a long day, but 100% worth it! Especially travelling via a very comfortable coach.
I highly recommend this tour!

Damon

I am so glad I went on this trip. Even Bath and LaCock, which I didn’t have any expectations for, turned out to be a blast. Every place we visited was well worth it. Eugene was probably the best host/guide I have ever had. He was entertaining, knowledgeable, humorous and super friendly. He made the long day not seem long at all. I would strongly recommend these guys.
This tour was AMAZING from start to finish!!! Gavin and the driver made this trip so much fun! and while the tour is a lot to rush through it is a "taster" tour which covers a lot for tourists!!

This was an awesome trip. Make sure that you rest the day before. Bath is a jewel of a city. Stone Henge was nice. Bath was my favorite city on the tour. The country side is amazing. There are unique shops along the narrow cobblestoned streets were amazing.

We had an absolutely fabulous day on this tour. Many great stops. Our tour guide, Gavin, was knowledgeable and knew intimate details about the places we visited. He had wonderful stories, sang for us, and taught us a bit of Welsh gaelic. His enthusiasm was contageous. Windsor Castle was a special stop where you can visit the Royal residences. We were astounded by this Castle and the area. Stonehenge left us speechless. Bath was just beautiful. The Cotswold where we had our meal was the last special stop. We were so fortunate to have Gavin take us on a lovely walk in this beautiful village after our meal. Beautiful farmlands, rolling hills, hedges, and stone walls. Unforgettable day.

Perfect tour for people who want to see a bunch of things briefly....which is me. Rach place was just long enough. Bath tour probably did have enough time to see the roman bath's but the line was long and I opted not wait and to and to take in the picturesque town instead. Stonehenge was the highlight for me and I also enjoyed the countryside of the Cotswolds. Gavin and Keith were our duo guide/driver and they were really exceptional. Gavin was fun, lighthearted with a great breadth of knowledge about British history. I learned a lot from his tour. He also took time to speak to each guest at the end of the trip and answered any travel questions they had. For me he directed me to Spitalfield Market for some shopping I was hoping to do...LOVE LOVE LOVED it! It was a hidden gem and just what I was looking for on my last day in London and I thoroughly enjoyed it. Thanks Gavin!

Gavin is amazing. Gavin was our tour guide and he made this tour so worth the money spent. He is genuinely cheerful, he's helpful with any questions, and very knowledgeable with London history. He's everything a tour guide should be. The stops were great. Stonehenge is definitely a must see. Everything before that was a plus. The countryside views on the way were breathtaking. Nothing bad to say at all about this trip. If there are any bad reviews, they didn't have Gavin as their tour guide. Thank you Gavin for an unforgettable trip!

Being an Aussie my wife & I select Premium Tours because of their Destinations.
This is always the reason we all book tours, but to have an extremely knowledgable & funny Guide & caring professional driver will top of a sensational day.
JR our bus driver along with Steve M were outstanding today.
Steve M guided tour along the way & at each destination was the most fun & we learnt so much from Steve M, his history knowledge is second to none. His sense of humour capped off an amazing day.
If you want to go on any tours, try to book on Steve M & coach driver JR at Premium Tours, You will be in extremely safe hands, learn a huge amount of history & around London, with many many laughs along the way. You will not be disappointed.
Unlike most people I did not feel rushed and enjoyed the day. Great driver and guide. The “lunch” is actually supper and should be labeled as such.

So first, the tour guide Gavin was awesome, very funny. The only reason I gave this tour a 4 instead of a 5 is I think it's too much to see in a day. Great tour guide, bus was clean and comfortable, awesome sights, good value for the money.

We only had an hour to see Windsor castle and were walking quickly through it in order to see everything. I was able to run through the roman baths and the bath Abbey just to get pics for Instagram but didn't have time to take it all in. Lacock lunch was very good. I felt like 1.5 hrs in Stonehenge was plenty. If I did in the future I would recommend a whole day in bath or just bath and Windsor castle to be able to enjoy it more. I would book this company again but probably try to do less in a day.

Gavin our tour guide was attentive, knowledgeable about the history of London and the surrounding countryside. He brought humor and fun and made sure we stayed on time. I would recommend this trip and tour guide without hesitation.
Our guide Tom and driver Tony were outstanding, very detailed and knowledgeable. A truly great experience.
My Mom and I had a great time on this tour! Our guide Steve and driver Nuno were fun and so informative. I learned more on this trip than all of school and laughed while doing it. Highly recommend.

Our tour started at 745 AM at Victoria station and ended at 845 PM at the same location. We traveled 350 plus miles and had a wonderful time. The guide Eugene was amazaning and kept us informed and our driver James did a tremendous job of keeping us safe and navigating the tight roads. The weather did not cooperate as it was cold, raining and windy but we braved the conditions. So small delays due to other passengers not getting back at the scheduled times but over all a great tour.

This tour was guided by Leon with Richardas our driver. Both were professional and extremely good at their job. I learned a lot from Leon about English history. This tour is not for you if you expect to spenda lot of time at any one place. It is great for you to check off some awesome bucket list items. Being in these places that have so much history is humbling. The trip took all day, but it was well worth the commitment. The only place I regret not having more time is at Bath. The things to see there require more time. Leon recommended reliable sandwiches at Windsor Castle!

We took this tour yesterday and Leon, our tour guide was great. He was very knowledgeable about each stop and quite entertaining. We were only in England for 3 days and wanted to experience as much as we could. This was definitely the tour for that. Not a lot of time was spent at each stop but that was necessary to be able to make it to every stop. Richard, our driver was amazing too. Thank you Leon and Richard!!!

Had a great time on this tour, James (our driver) and Eugene were very accommodating and kept us engaged with many anecdotes during the ride. Given the fact that there are 4 stops, including a pub lunch (also very good) - the "wandering time" at the stops was kept to a minimum -which meant that the feeling of immersion at the attractions wasn't really there. But again, that's to be expected given the long distance (nearly 300 miles) that needs to be covered and the number of places you get to see. So it's a bit if a whistle-stop thing, but nevertheless, James and Eugene made it very enjoyable, and the company clearly puts an effort into running a professional operation. Recommended for anyone who wants to knock these items off their "bucket list".

We spent the day with Leon and Martin on the tour of Windsor, then on to Stonehenge continuing to Bath and culminating with dinner in Lacock. Leon was an amazing guide - very knowledgeable and he had a great sense of humor and story-telling style. We thoroughly enjoyed the day and although the tour was a bit longer than advertised the time went by with stories and conversation. It was a day well spent and we have zero regrets. This duo is a hit on our vacation in London and the UK

Eugene and Nuno were fantastic! Would recommend this experience to anyone looking to see Stonehenge, Bath and Windsor. Nuno was a stellar driver and Eugene was both knowledgeable and entertaining. Great experience for everyone! Thanks for a great trip guys!

Eugene was an EXCELLENT TOUR GUIDE!!! He really set the bar high on tours because all the other tours we did after was no where near as good. I was so pleased with his knowledge, sense of humor, and personality that I tipped him 15 pounds. I highly suggest this tour and try to REQUEST Eugene as your guide, you wont regret it!

We booked the tour to Windsor but had to change to Hampton Court. Our tour guide Leon and driver John were fantastic. Leon is very knowledgeable and very interesting. He was able to provide a lot of interesting information about the area. There was an accident on the highway which delayed us quite a bit. Leon and John went out of there way to determine a way to alter the schedule so that we were able to see everything. Lunch was very good and seeing Stonehenge was awesome. Highly recommend this tour.

A friend and I had a wonderful day visiting Stonehenge, Lacock, Bath and also Hampton Court (as Windsor Castle was unavailable for the date that we selected).

Our tour guide David was very knowledgeable and led us on a personalised tour of of Hampton Court. We would have felt completely lost without him! David's knowledge of English History was extraordinary and he helped us to appreciate the historic significance of all of the places that we visited.

We especially appreciated the timely organisation of the day so that we could still visit the Roman Baths in Bath. It was beautiful to watch the sun setting over the baths, and we made the most of the 5pm tour led by one of the tour guides at the Roman Baths Museum.

Also, the bus driver Daniel was very courteous and an excellent driver.

We highly recommend Premium Tours.

Not only did Leon and Tony run an organized timely trip, Leon is thoroughly delightful. He added so much local color and commentary to the history lessons that even our teenage daughters were listening. I definitely recommend this trip as a “must do” if In London. Seek out Leon as he is very knowledgeable about all things London with a great sense of humor but completely serious when appropriate. I wouldn’t change a thing about this day as it was perfect and no problem squeezing so many experiences in to one day. Thank you premier
I's recommend visiting here as it really makes you think. Who and what in the world made this? I always think about this.
Had a wonderful time. Steve M was a great guide and very knowledgeable. Joe was a magnificent driver. A lot to see in one day but was able to fit it all in! Definitely would recommend.

Just got back from an all day tour with Leon and Richard. Could not have asked for a better guide and driver. I'm a big history lover but I tune out most tour guides as they are boring or sound like they are reading off of a script but Leon was very entertaining and provided tons of info not just on the locations we went to but on every place we passed through including London. The tours and prosses went smoothly due to easy to follow directions. The pub lunch was delicious and loved the small town it was in, would have liked a little more time there but great to stop through regardless. This was the first time and driver did not scare me with their driving, Richard was very skilled. The couch was so comfortable and enjoyed the great views from up top. Only thing that would have been nice would have been entrance to Roman Baths included in the price. This was the best tour I had been on due to the guide and driver. Leon even helped us pick the right train station for after the tour and took time to talk with everyone.

The trip was the HIGHLIGHT of our Ireland/London vacation. The sights were amazing and Leon was very knowledgeable, approachable and quite a sense of humor. James was our driver and he was incredible managing the tour bus on some of those roads. We felt safe with James as our driver. He was also personable and had a smile for everyone.
Stonehenge was incredible! The only negative comment would be it states that there is wi-fi available but there is not... no one on the tour had access.
Pretty cool to be onsite at Stonehenge - listen to the history and see the surrounding towns like Bath, Box (home of Peter Gabriel), and Lacock. Worth a trip out there.

We were on two tours. The first with Gavin was superb. He's very engaging and knowledgeable. He set the bar very high. Unfortunately, our tour the next day was with a different company and very different guide.

I am a flight attendant and have traveled all over the world, and taken many trips , this tour was by far one of the best I have taken. Gavin was our guide he was extremely engaging, knowledgeable,and personal as well as entertaining. Always Leary about booking group lunch but Pub was fantastic and so was the town. A true 5 star with Gavin as our guide.

Just returned from a trip to Paris and London. With only 3 days in London we wanted to see as many sites as possible so this tour was a good one for us. Our tour guide Gavin was the best ever! Not only was he informative, he was so funny and kept us all going for the entire 12 hour day! Totally knowledgeable about all the sights and even offered some of his own little tidbits to add color to the history. Loved it!

Fabulous one day trip. Totally recommend if you are in London and want to see a bit more of England. Tour guide, Stephen was well informed, friendly and very professional. So was our driver Kevin! Took great care of us all. Great way to spend a full day in the UK:) Made me want to go come back to visit!

My wife and I celebrated New Years 2019 in London. On 30Dec we had the pleasure of spending an entire day in the country side on a coach tour. We started our morning at Windsor where we walked around the grounds and listened to audio narrated tours of the various rooms and displays Next we explored the ruins of Stonehenge where we learned the true origins of the monoliths. Around noon we had a delicious pub lunch in the quaint village of Lacock where we got to step back in time bit. The last stop on our day tour was to view the roman baths in the town of Bath.We enjoyed all aspects of this tour. We highly recommend this day tour to everyone.

Gavin was a great guide and full of information! The tour itself is very long (12.5 hours) and we did not get lunch until 3PM. Along the way, there are a few places to buy food, but have a good breakfast if you don’t want to spend in overpriced cafes at tour stops. The lunch was very good, but small portion. READ THE FINE PRINT. We thought the tour included admission to the Roman Baths at Bath. It does not and there is an 18GBP charge per person for entry.

Frank and Manuel gave us the BEST tour. We loved it all and if there was one negative, it was maybe just a bit to much for day as we would have liked more time at Windsor castle, Lacock and Bath. Just the right amount of time for Stonehenge. We loved Frank's knowledge and commentary!

We signed up to this tour to see a number of highlights in one day. From the very beginning we were in Gavin’s capable hands, he professionally catered for all levels of our group with great care and humour. He managed to ensure we were first through the gates at Windsor and gave a fantastic history and overview before we entered the castle so we all felt well informed and didn’t have to rely on audio guides. He ensured we knew where best to view the changing of the guard. The travel between sites was hilarious with Gavin’s fabulous and informative historical facts and anecdotes. Wherever possible he added in any extra sites he could. We felt we saw so much in a very short time, but one of the highlights of the day was truly Gavin. Our only disappointment was not having more time in Windsor, however, as Gavin said at the beginning of the day, this was a great taster and he gave tips on returning and what to see there. Take snacks as lunch is quite late.

December 29, 2018 —

Pros:

Our guide, Gavin, was a great guide. Never was there a boring or dull moment during the tour. He was funny and had a wealth of infornation to share. While he sported a British accent, still we could pick up his words with ease. Our driver, Ash, drove the coach smoothly, avoiding abrupt stops that otherwise would have caused nausea in us.

Lunch at George’s Inn in Lacock was good. Good fish and chips plus good ambiance.

The City of Bath was amazing. The Roman bath was well preserved and well presented. We got there while we still had 1 hour to explore the baths. Entrance fee was not included in the price of the tour.

On the way to Bath, we got to see the tatched roofs of the houses in Cotswold.

We got to see a portion of the changing of the guards ceremony in Windsor Castle.

The bus made two stops after the tour: one at Gloucester Road Station, which was close to Holiday Inn Kensington Forum, where we were staying, and the other at Victoria Coach Station. So it was kind of door-to-door trip.

Cons:

With 4 sites to visits, it was really a “taste each site tour” since we spent only 1 to 1.5 hours at each site. It was to be expected.

Our group was large - 78 participants - riding a double decker coach. While we would have wanted to ride on the upper deck, at least we got front seats on the lower deck.

Because the boarding gate at Victoria Coach Station was smallish, it was quite crowded. Different tour groups were mixed up at the boarding gate. It was a bit disorganized there.

This was surprisingly a great way to spend a day in England. Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, a 1300 century pub, all topped off with a Roman city.
