It was informative, and exciting traveling to see some premier tourist attractions, and our host/tour Guide was fun and fantastic. We met some great people on the bus and hung out with them after the tour. All in all 10/10!

This entire tour was wonderful from Stonehenge to Windsor Castle to Bath to the pub lunch in Lacock. Our guide was also wonderful. While I forget her name, she was an older lady with a rainbow wand used to guide us! Very personable and took good care of us. You are free to wander at each site on your own so you don't have to actually be on a guided tour each time which is nice. She gave us all a time to be back at the bus and let us do our own thing. If you miss the bus that's on you for not managing your time better. They tell you multiple times that they will leave you and when to be back at the bus. Everyone's schedule cannot be changed because of a couple knuckleheads. I do recommend bringing snacks as you get the lunch in the middle of the trip so it's just handy in case you need something in between.

What makes a good tour, is the guide. Julian was wonderful. He was extremely informative, very funny and friendly. The ride between stops was never dull, Julian had us laughing the whole time.
The first stop was Windsor Castle, which was very interesting to see but this was a self guided and very short (45 minute) tour. Our next stop was Bath home of the Roman Baths, Bath Abby and Jane Austen. Next stop was Lacock, which is like walking back in time. If you're a Harry Potter fan this is a must do. Last but not least, Stonehenge! Wow! I kept telling my husband, "I can't believe we're here!
The whole tour was fantastic!
Toured with my adult children, found the whole experience amazing. Lucy was organised informed us of quick and easy things to do, utterly enjoyed the experience.

Natalia was a fantastic guide for our day trip very informative and patient made our day even more pleasant. Great destinations Windsor Castle
Bath and Stonehenge also lunch at Lacock Tavern all added to experience would highly recommend.
It was a lovely experience made possible by our guide Gavin. He made the journey so enjoyable and was always very kind. Thanks!!!

Tour started at 7:45am, and we returned by around 8:30pm. The tour guide Daniel was excellent. He knew a lot about all of the sites we were visiting, and presented a nice history of London and England in general during the bus rides to the various locations. I liked that he made suggestions on things we should aim to see, but that we were given time to explore on our own. Our bus driver Steve was efficient at getting us to the locations fairly quickly.
Overall I enjoyed the tour as we were able to see many interesting sites in one day. The lunch at the pub was also pretty good. I didn't feel overly rushed, and the guide was very clear on the times we should be back on the bus. I felt that there was very little time wasted as everything was explained to us during the bus rides. I especially appreciated how quickly they got us to the first location: Windsor - we were basically the first people in line (and the line gets long very quickly). It might have been nicer to be able to spend more time at each location, but that is the trade-off for this type of highlight tour. If you're mainly interested in doing a more comprehensive visit of these sites, then this is not the tour for you.

Lots of items on the itinerary, probably too much to try and see in one day. Our guide Steve was fantastic, very knowledgeable about English history and the places we visited. He has a good sense of humour and kept up his commentary throughout the trip. Pub early dinner was a highlight in a delightful ancient village, Lacock, that is used for filming of various British TV series and specials. Only drawback to the trip (and it may be trivial) was the coach we were in with approximately 50 people. The coach had no chair-back storage pouches or places for cups or toilet facilities. The second bus that was required for our trip (lots of people took this tour) had all of the above including meal trays on the chair-backs. This trip is a good sampling (it doesn't give you a lot of time in each place for extra venturing nor a second pint at the pub) of some of the sites to visit again if you have more time.

I need to warn you. Don't be confused between London Victoria Station and Victoria Coach Station. I was using the underground to get around and on a previous day saw the sign for coach station and thought No Problem!! When you take the exit that say coach station it will take you outside where you are standing on a sidewalk going ummmm. There is a paper sign up on a pole with an arrow. OK,,, so I walk to the corner looking for it. Well after A LOT of walking around found out that once you get to that corner you need to cross the street and walk down a couple more blocks. The station is on the right hand side of the street. Super annoying so glad I started out early to give me time for all this wondering around. The Trip. Windsor was outstanding. So sad you can not take pictures inside. Plenty of time to go through and hit a gift shop on the way out. They give you a hand held device with headphones so you can listen to a guided tour according to area. Bath. Well a good map of the area would have been helpful. They turn you lose to do what you want. I was trying to find the Jane Austin Center but confusing getting around and by the time I found it needed to find my way back to where the bus dropped us off. Lines were too long to get into Romen Baths so most people did not go in. More time needs to be spent here.Late lunch at The George Inn in Lacock. That was expected. Stonehenge was lovely. They give you a hand held device to listen to different areas based on the number. Overall was a great day.

Our tour guide gave us specific instructions from the bus terminal throughout the day and evening making for a well-run and timely tour - meaning they kept to the schedule.Our tour started with an hour drive to Windsor, a short time in queue, about 90 minutes to look around, grab a quick snack and re-board the bus by 11:15am. We took about 2 hours to drive to Bath. It was a little less clear to me what to do with my time here, but had I done any reading or been more awake on the ride - I'm sure it was mentioned. We toured the Abbey and it was fascinating. We also shopped a bit and walked the river. Driving from point to point revealed the rolling hills of the Cotswolds. Lacock provided a 3pm lunch. Lots of homes in this small village have been used by filmmakers. Off to Stonehenge where we were about the last people there so we had lots of access to the things to be seen there. Overall, it was good variety of life outside London.

I can say that this is the best tour with them, guide Leon and driver Fernando are very accomodating. i just wish we have more time in Windsor since the queues are very long in getting inside. As we wanted to see the parade of guards we hurried down not able to see much of the castle.
i also wish that there are more time in Bath to explore it more. Fyi, queues in the roman bath is overwhelming we couldnt get through.
Dont expect the lunch to be so great but not bad, it is free except for the sodas and other drinks.
Viaiting Stone henge last is a good timing , since there are none pople left in the late afternoon. we had the best shots in getting some pics. I had a good sleep going back to London from the bus. So i recommend as u can feel sit back, relax and see the views.

Leon was an excellent guide (I hope you are now feeling well, Leon). However, our day trip on 6 July 2018 was very disappointing and frustrating. The pub' lunch' at Lacock did not happen until 6pm. In itself, that is not a bad idea as it saves having to buy or prepare dinner when you get back to London after a long day. But why call it 'lunch', and why not advise passengers in advance when food will be provided? After the long wait, the food at the pub in Lacock was by far the worse meal we had in out 10-day stay in England. The second problem of the trip was that too much time was spent at Stonehenge and there was not enough time in Bath to visit either the Roman Baths or the Georgian townhouses. This was a huge disappointment to us. With some simple rearrangements of the schedule this could really have been a wonderful day trip.

Pun intended. Both made our tour wonderful, lively and convenient! History on wheels!
It was a lovely sunny day for this tour and we do appreciate how much we learned from them. Cheers!

We enjoyed the places we visited (Windsor Castle/Stonehenge/Bath/Laycock village) however the guide was extremely annoying. Wish she had talked more about the facts on the places we visited than her personal and prejudiced opinions about the monarchy and Brexit.
This is something that you definitely should visit if you ever visit London. You can spend whole day here and you will not regret it. Great for history lovers

This is a great tour to see a few places we wouldn’t have otherwise seen on our own. Yes, rushed however it was totally worth it. If you don’t want to be rushed I’d suggest hiring a car and driving yourself to take your time however you’ll be battling the rest of the tour buses to line up at each place! We had Lucy as our guide and she was brilliant, witty and extremely knowledgeable. Learnt quite a few new bits of information, it was great! She made the bus drive between places more enjoyable with her commentary, rather than sitting bored in silence. Each place has somewhere to get food/drinks and bathrooms so don’t worry about those things. Overall both myself and my partner were extremely impressed with this tour and 100% glad we did it.

As expected, there were not a lot of time on each stop, but the most important thing is a guide and our guide John was great, very knowledgeable and so funny. We had a great time and a lot of laugh. Lacock was a big surprise, wonderful small town for history (and movie) lovers.
tour was as expected and described in the details. However, lunch was not very good. Would suggest having them pick a different venue in the future.

We really enjoyed our time in this tour, it did feel a bit rushed but it was made clear from the beginning so our expectations were set.
The coach was very comfy and our guide Leon was very knowledgeable. We took some beautiful country side roads which were a welcome change after being in the city for a week. Highly recommended!
Best tour manager we have ever had. He was clear and made sure everyone was welcome and informed. He needs a pay rise.
Each location was wonderful. Weather helped us enjoy them more. A nice tour with lots of history. Food wasn't bad neither. All, well worth it.

We went here and it was a lovely day,
Good place to go , very quick but fun
I would recommend going to Stonehenge
Very well organized a definite must has something for everyone my hat is off to the guide "NICK" a very knowledgeable and stand up guy CHEERS

We had a wonderful tour led by Carol who was so informative and kept us all on time with this tight schedule. If you only have a short time to see a lot, this is it! Wonderful taster to this part of England. Fabulous lunch as well at Lacock! Highly recommend.

First off, the driver Christian and the guide Dan made this trip a success. Dan is hilarious and provided great info along the way.

This tour is not for the person who wants to spend a half day each looking at a castle, a few rocks, or a couple of small towns. It is great for those who are limited on the time they are willing to spend on tour, and would like a bit of variety. Just about the moment I was bored, we were off to the next place. Perfect!

We very much enjoyed this trip but we had no idea how busy it would be. We were VERY rushed to see everything in the time allowed, and found ourselves running (literally) to make the bus departure. Windsor Castle/St. George's Cathedral are stunning and should have at least a half day to themselves. Bath Cathedral is pretty but it was too crowded to see the Roman baths (and expensive and entrance not included) in the time we had. Lacock was OK, but I don't think I would go there again. Our driver was amazing and our tour guide was awesome. Premium tours looked after us well, kept us organized and on time. Totally awesome!

I went on a full day tour with Premium travel yesterday, I must say I really enjoyed the tour, it’s very packed but the guide (Lucy) and driver (Cyrus) we amazing. It started very early to help cut down the queuing time at Windsor Castle, and indeed, we were the 3rd group queuing. This tour aims to give you an overview of these sights, if you need to explore details, you need to come back again. I have also enjoyed the ‘British humour’ from Lucy, she is knowledgeable, experienced and is very well organized. Love it!

This was a remarkable trip! Our guide, I think it was Lucy, and driver, Kevin were fantastic! The background information shared was incredible. Visiting Lacock was excellent! The meal at The George was top shelf! We were even "entertained" on the way to Lacock when we met a lorry, going the opposite way, at a narrow section of road. A bit of a delay but it added a bit of "drama" to make the trip just that much more memorable!

What an amazing tour. Our driver Rob and tour guide Jose were very professional. Rob is an outstanding driver who made us feel safe while Jose was extremely entertaining from the moment we left the bus station. It's a long day but well worth it. The beauty and history we experienced was priceless. Thanks again Rob and Jose from Premium Tours. Lorraine and Jeff from Huntington Beach CA. 10/20/2017
